notes.title: 2025 Mid-Winter Update
notes.content:
Salutations Quakers,

Here are the patch notes for the Mid-Winter Update, now live: 

[h1]Critical Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue that prevented the player from loading into consecutive matches while the DARK MATTER GUN was equipped
[*] Fixed compatibility issue preventing the game from launching on Windows 10 LTSC 1809
[/list][h1]Game Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Max FPS limit unlocked
[*] The in-game Settings & Social menu can now be used during warmup or while dead, without it closing upon respawn
[*] In Custom Game lobbies, you can no longer accidentally moved players between podiums when clicking on/through and overlapping UI
[*] Improvements to Bot movement (movement skills, not navigation)
[*] Arena Kings re-added to Ranked Playlist
[*] Skill Rating values reset in Ranked
[/list][h1]Map Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Longest Yard CTF - Moved RG to center, moved MH to high base, moved HMG to lower base
[*] Cursed Soul - Updated vegetation outside the map
[/list][h1]Early Preview of Season 26 content for Gold Ranger owners[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quake 3: Team Arena's TETANUS SHOT Starting Shotgun
[*] Quake 3: Team Arena's PROXIMITY LAUNCHER Tri-bolt
[*] Quake 3: Team Arena's VULKAN Heavy Machinegun
[/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Heavily reduced the purple screen flash, caused by the DARK MATTER GUN projectile, when firing and moving forward
[*] Fixed missing passives (for BJ, Eisen, and DK) in Clan Arena and Round Duel
[*] Fixed third person muzzle FX locator for Old Painless Q2 Chaingun
[/list]

notes.title: Quake Champions Season 25
notes.content:
Salutations, Quakers! In this December update we've got a whole lot of NEW: vicious new vanity items, new custom game options, and two new competitive modes! Plus, some map fixes and miscellaneous updates. Check out the full notes:

[h1]New Content[/h1][list]
[*] Quake 2 CHAINFIST Gauntlet
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/ab55b09c47ae1441042ce6e4c004118bcb2a0a86.png[/img][list]
[*] Quake 4 DARK MATTER GUN Rocket Launcher
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/109f8ea1ae2f54fb8355891fbccda9c684e61e29.png[/img][list]
[*] Quake Wars STROGG LIGHTNING PISTOL Lightning Gun
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/33675657fae8763c7c126f82d4787907882d6577.png[/img][h1]New Competitive Game Modes added to Custom Game[/h1]
[list]
[*] CTF Tourney - 1-8 players, no bots. One-champion-limit-per-team, 5 second weapon respawn times, no breakables, no killer target cams, and no killer death HP stacks
[*] TDM Tourney - 1-8 players, no bots. One-champion-limit-per-team, 15 second weapon respawn times, no item timers, no breakables, no killer target cams, no killer death HP stacks, 10s->5s max forced respawns, and Friendly Fire (will initially test 50% damage).
[/list][h1]New Custom Game Options[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/5eae3a81121f930d88bd1f088a3b51f6ac7ce4d5.png[/img][list]
[*] Force Champion (supports None, Mystery Champion, or a specific champion of your choosing)
[*] Starting Weapons
[*] Weapon Respawn Time
[*] Active Abilities (now also supports enabling them in modes where they weren't present)
[*] Refresh Ability on Spawn (cooldown reset when a player respawns)
[*] Max Health & Armor on Spawn
[*] Health & Armor Decay
[*] Self-Damage
[*] Instagib Weapons
[*] Instagib Abilities
[*] Infinite Ammo
[*] Enemy Knockback
[*] Friendly Fire
[*] Spawn Power-ups
[*] Spawn Health
[*] Spawn Armor
[*] Spawn Ammo
[*] Spawn Pickup Weapons
[/list][h1]Map Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Blood Run - Fixed an issue that could cause players to fall out of the map during warmup, reported in Clan Arena
[*] Vestibule of Exile - Fixed decal collision on HA and LG jumppads
[/list][h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] CTF - Increased the size of the flag pickup trigger, 0.5m to 0.8m radius
[*] CTF - Active abilities are now disabled when picking up the flag
[*] Pings on the Duel scoreboard are now colored green, yellow, or red based on connection quality
[*] Removed Mystery Champion game modes from Custom Game, as you can now enable it in any game mode using the new settings options
[/list][h1]Services Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated anti-cheat, resolved Daemon Tools compatibility issue
[/list]

notes.title: Quake Champions - October 3 Hotfix
notes.content:
We've fixed some issues in today's hotfix, now live:

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when another Keel player or a bot fires a grenade that explodes after bouncing and hitting no opponents
[*] Fixed Keel's grenade explosion from showing up at the map origin
[*] Fixed Keel grenade explosions not being visible when directly hitting players or when taking a direct hit from Keel's grenade
[*] Fixed Doom Slayer Berserk speed
[*] Fixed Athena's pull speed. Holding backwards will no longer cause her pull speed to be slower than intended
[*] Fixed double body collisions during Athena grapple body slams
[*] Fixed Athena's missing grapple flyby sound
[*] Fixed the ETF Rifle's fletchette nail visibility
[*] Fixed a hit beep bug when the damage dealt was exactly 25, 50, or 75
[*] Fixed errors from deprecated sound event sources
[*] Fixed gore blood FX particle emission source
[*] Fixed breakables FX generation
[*] Fixed Q4 RL explosion sounds
[*] Replaced pitching effects in projectile flyby sound events
[/list][h1]Service Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Anti-cheat updates

[*] Updated the D3D Compiler Library

notes.title: Quake Champions Season 24
notes.content:
We're at [i][b]ground zero[/b][/i] for Season 24, and there will be a [i][b]reckoning[/b][/i] with some brand new weapon vanities inspired by the Quake II Mission Packs! Check out the full notes for today's fall season update: 

[h1]New Battle Pass & Store Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the PHALANX PARTICLE CANNON Tri-bolt from Q2: The Reckoning
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/2abab100f35d386ad9d69321b089a76239ac9a6c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added the ETF RIFLE Super Nailgun from Q2: Ground Zero
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/153cb26e34fe26df251deaf432e39d1eb767b310.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added the ION RIPPER Rocket Launcher from Q2: The Reckoning
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/5a336799a78226aa52c99b9c546e45572698e960.png[/img]

[h1]Performance Optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*] Code optimizations for CPU & Memory
[*] Optimized sound events, reducing their CPU & Memory loads
[*] Optimizations to Tri-bolt water impacts
[*] Fixed two memory leak fixes
[*] Marked several effects as low priority and renamed the 'Weapon Effects' option in Adv Video to 'Low Priority FX'
[/list][h1]Sound Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved the volume and mixing of the footstep and falling sounds
[*] Elevation sound balancing is now only for third-person steps and jumps
[*] Improved the firing sounds for the Freezegun (1st & 3rd) and the Disruptor Plasmagun (1st)
[*] Teammate Volume now defaults to 10
[*] Marked unnecessary first-person weapon sounds as ambient for Gauntlets, Q4 SNG, and Q2R Tri-bolt (PPC). These will now be affected by the Ambient Volume slider and from the silent-walking ambient stun.
[*] Project is back to 44.1k instead of 48k to address some mixer performance issues
[*] Resampled some of the legacy 22k sound sources to 44.1k
[*] Enemies once again have 3 pain sound ranges (1-25, 26-50, 51-75)
[*] Reduced the 1st person volume of Slash's skating sounds
[*] Reduced the chance of Anarki & Slash's long VO from playing
[/list][h1]Weapons[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Machinegun [/b][list]
[*] Spread reduced from 0.02 to 0.01
[/list][*] [b]Shotgun [/b][list]
[*] Is 16 pellets, rings of 1, 3, 5, 7 - 5 damage each. A total of 80 damage.
[/list][*] [b]Super Shotgun[/b] [list]
[*] Is also 16 pellets, rings of 1, 3, 5, 7 - 5 damage each. A total of 80 damage. 
[*]However, the SSG now gains bonus damage based on range. The range damage, is up to 40 additional points, bringing the total possible damage to 120. Full bonus granted within the first 5 meters and then falls off linearly until there is no range bonus at 10m.[/list][*] [b]Shotgun & Super Shotgun[/b] [list]
[*] Falloff distance is 1 point of damage every 19.2m. Falloff is now greatly reduced due to the above changes.
[*] Decreased nearspread from 0.6 to 0.25 m
[/list][*] [b]Nailgun [/b] [list]
[*] Damage increased from 12 to 15
[/list][*] [b]Super Nailgun[/b] [list]
[*] Damage increased from 15 to 20
[/list][*] [b]Nailgun & Super Nailgun[/b] [list]
[*] Nail projectile collision reverted to a point trace, for performance (and balance)
[/list][*] [b]Tri-bolt[/b] [list]
[*] Projectile collision reverted to a point trace, for performance
[/list][*] [b]Rocket Launcher[/b] [list]
[*] Reverted rocket projectile collision reverted to a point trace, for performance
[/list][*] [b]Lightning Gun[/b] [list]
[*] Damage increased from 6 to 7
[/list][/list][h1]Champions[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Clutch[/b]
[list][*]Air-Dodge reduced from 9.02 to 8 m/s and to 7 m/s during shield usage[/list][*][b]DOOM Slayer[/b]
[list][*]Berserk mechanics improved to make it more reliable, including hit detection and jump-punch physics
[*]Can no longer double jump during Berserk[/list][/list][h1]Maps[/h1]
[list][*][b]Cursed Soul[/b][list]
[*] Lighting improvements
[*] Quad and Protection now swap locations each spawn
[*] Fixed collision on sand patch at the top of the water well
[*] Fixed a seam right of the doorway from the NG room to the MH room

[*] Fixed a seam in a doorway near upper crypt
[*] Improved collision at stone to health jump in throne room
[*] Improved collision at lava teleporter dropdown
[*] Minor skybox updates[/list][*][b]Citadel[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bots to getting stuck on the soul obelisk in Sacrifice
[/list][*][b]Lockbox[/b]
[list]
[*] Item layout changed a lot; have fun!
[*] Trap updated, now deep and deadly
[/list][/list][h1]Miscellaneous Updates[/h1]

notes.title: Quake Champions - QuakeCon 2024 Update
notes.content:
Salutations, Quakers! We're just TWO WEEKS AWAY from QuakeCon, and to celebrate we're releasing a brand new map in today's update: [b]CURSED SOUL![/b] Plus: a new QuakeCon bundle is available in the store, and we'll show you a sneak peek of a FREE reward coming August 5-12!

[h1]New Map: Cursed Soul[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/eefa8340d7483b0cbad56a686b9aa3b76e9d8f03.jpg[/img]
The ankh is a symbol of resurrection, and you'll be subjecting your opponents to a lot of respawning in this all new 8-player map! 

Available for modes: TDM, DM, SAC, CTF, CA, IG, UHT, and I9.

[h1]QuakeCon Qontent[/h1]
[list]
[*] QuakeCon 2024 Nameplate & Profile Icon store bundle (available now!)
[*] QuakeCon Tri-Bolt - Free login reward available [b]August 5-12[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/2b3c83e4a426c2d1c612631143c88a13200fba74.png[/img][h1]New Audio Setting[/h1]
[list]
[*] Teammate Volume - Lowers or mutes your teammate's movement, VO, and shot sounds
[/list]
[h1]Sound Engine Updated[/h1]
[list]

notes.title: Quake Champions Season 19 Update
notes.content:
Salutations, Quakers!

Today's Season 19 update features improvements and optimizations to the game engine, in addition to balance changes and beach-themed Battle Pass content, just in time for summer! 

We have also included the Season 17 and Season 18 patch notes below the current season's notes, for your perusal. 

[h1]Season 19 Battle Pass[/h1]
We're going to the beach in this season's Battle Pass, with items like a new surfboard for Anarki; a fishing hat for BJ and a sun hat for Nyx; new watergun skins for the Lightning Gun and Tri-bolt; and your own little slice of the sandy shore with a new Summer Beach Podium!

notes.title: Season 13 Winter Update
notes.content:
Season's greetings, Quakers! 

It's that time of year when the stars align [i]just right[/i] in the cold winter sky and the Elder Gods deign to bestow gifts upon those who fight for their amusement. This year, they're presenting their Champions with an all-new arena, [b][i]Insomnia[/i][/b], along with a new weapon vanity in the seasonal Battle Pass, balance tweaks, and bug fixes. 

Happy holidays, and have a fragging New Year! 

[h2]Season 13 Battle Pass[/h2]
This season's Battle Pass is the gift that keeps on giving, with tons of rewards for you to unlock including holiday-themed profile icons, nameplates, and vanity items!

[h2]New Vanity - ICE BEAM Lightning Gun[/h2]
Give your enemies the cold shoulder with this new ice-themed Lightning Gun vanity, available in the Season 13 Battle Pass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/7fce8ead097158df1c4670966ab6761e32a6116b.png[/img]
[h2]New Map - Insomnia[/h2]
[i]I shall never sleep calmly again when I think of the horrors that lurk ceaselessly behind life in time and in space, and of those unhallowed blasphemies from elder stars which dream beneath the sea...[/i]

Your restless battle continues within the ancient stone walls of this cathedral-fortress to Volkerh, the Whispering One. This moonlit arena is available for Duel, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Clan Arena modes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/6c284fa32b3fa95128e7d11c500eacbaa1832596.png[/img]
[h2]Audio Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Ambient Volume slider
[*] Added Announcer Volume slider

[/list]
[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Deep Embrace[/b]
[list][*]Updated collision at the top of the stairs near the Rocket Launcher
[*]Fixed a major collision issue at the Light Armor "death window"[/list][*] [b]Exile[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a hole in the geometry near the Mega Health
[*]Updated Collision throughout the map[/list][/list]

[*] [b]DOOM Slayer -[/b] Changed ability duration from 6 seconds → 5 seconds, and increased delay between Punches from 500ms → 1s
[*] [b]Scalebearer -[/b] Forward acceleration 0.85 → 0.75
[*] Unified movement & knockback box sizes within weight classes to 0.8m, 0.9m, and 1.0m:
[list][*] Anarki 0.9 → 0.8
[*] BJ Blazkowicz 1.0 → 0.9
[*] Death Knight 1.0 → 0.9
[*] Doom Slayer 0.8 → 0.9
[*] Eisen 0.85 → 0.9 
[*] Ranger 0.95 → 0.9
[*] Strogg 0.8 → 0.9
[*] Visor 1.0 → 0.9
[*] Clutch 1.2 → 1.0 (knockback only)
[*] Keel 0.9 → 1.0
[*] Sorlag 1.2 → 1.0 (knockback only)[/list][*] Unified standing and crouching view heights into three groups (light/medium, heavy, Anarki) as their previous values only slightly differed
[/list]
[h2]Weapon Updates[/h2]
[list][*][b]Shotgun:[/b] 
[list][*]Reduced pellet count and increased damage per pellet (same max damage)
[list][*]Old: 20 pellets x 4 dmg = 80, SSG - 30 pellets x 4 dmg = 120
[*]New: 16 pellets x 5 dmg = 80, SSG - 24 pellets x 5 dmg = 120[/list][*]Falloff Distance: reduced pellet damage by 1 for every 9.6 meters (384u) (Minimum 1 dmg per pellet when over 1920u away)[/list][*][b]Nailguns:[/b] 
[list][*]The Nailgun splash radius now matches the Super Nailgun splash radius of 20u
[*]Both the Nailgun and Super Nailgun projectiles have been changed to 1800 ups instead of 2000 ups[/list][/list]

notes.title: Quake Champions Summer 2021 Update
notes.content:
As the old summer adage goes, “sun’s out, guns out”—and there’ll be plenty of weapons-in-hand in the Arena! (Hopefully yours pointed at the enemy, and not vice-versa.) We’re celebrating 25 years of Quake in this update, so get ready for a rocket blast from the past with a retro map, classic weapon skins, and lots more—including new anti-cheat measures to keep the fighting fair!

[h1]UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
[h2]New Map[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]THE DARK ZONE[/b] – The textures may be retro, but the gameplay is timeless. Return to one of the classic Quake multiplayer maps, DM6 – The Dark Zone. 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/7d9a28d4c8de27817bc9e0b4118af647e0d5a44a.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Customizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]TRAILBLAZER Tri-bolt[/b] - Classic Quake Legacy Grenade Launcher
[*] [b]LAST-RITUAL Super Nailgun[/b] - Quake Mission Pack 1: Scourge of Armagon Laser Cannon
[*] [b]REAPER Railgun[/b] - Classic Quake "Legacy" Railgun—Ranger's Quake third-person World View Weapon Model!
[*] [b]QCON 2021 Gauntlet[/b] - This commemorative gauntlet will be available during QuakeCon 2021!
[*] [b]CHROME SHADERS for all Champions[/b] - Red, Pink, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Silver, and Black
[*] [b]PINK Champion Shaders [/b]- One for each Champion
[*] [b]PINK Weapon Shaders [/b]- One for each weapon that has color shaders
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/6da9d4f667c0dc71d166e392d2efb353f3695311.jpg[/img]
[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] The weapons and some vanity items from previous Battle Pass seasons are now available in the store.
[/list]
[h2]New Client Options[/h2]
[h3]GAME OPTIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency[/b] - Reflex Low Latency Mode aligns game engine work to complete just-in-time for rendering, eliminating the GPU render queue and reducing CPU back pressure in GPU intensive scenes. This delivers latency reductions above and beyond existing driver-only techniques, such as NVIDIA Ultra Low Latency Mode. Available in Game Settings. (Nvidia Maxwell, Pascal, Turing, or Ampere GPUs with R455 drivers required.)
[*] [b]Menu Framerate Limit[/b] - Added a max FPS Limit for while in the main menu. (Default 120, min 60, max 250)
[*] [b]Streamer Mode[/b] - Use the Main Menu Framerate Limit when minimized to maintain the stream's FPS quality.
[/list]
[h3]HUD OPTIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Damage Number Summation[/b] - Damage numbers now show a total of recent damage dealt to a target, aggregating high rate of fire weapons into a combined damage dealt number. Select between Off, Damage Type (default), and All Recent Damage. 
[*] [b]Crosshair Hit Color[/b] - Choose a crosshair color to flash when dealing damage. Must be enabled with "Crosshair Hit Color Enabled".
[*] [b]Crosshair Hit Scale[/b] - Players may now choose to scale their crosshair either larger or smaller when hitting a target.
[*] [b]Speedometer[/b] - Players may choose between "Off", "Below Crosshair", and "Below Portrait" to alter the HUD placement of the Speedometer.
[*] [b]Ability Info Position [/b]- Players may now choose to move the Ability Icon from the center of the screen and push it to either the LEFT or RIGHT side, useful for either players with centered weapons, or those who just wish to group this information near either the Health & Armor Vitals or the Ammo info.
[/list]
[h3]CONTROL OPTIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Mouse Input[/b] – now choose between Raw Mouse or DirectX mouse input
[*] [b]Respawn[/b] - You may now change the default "SPACE" bind for issuing a respawn on the death screen.
[/list]
[h3]AUDIO OPTIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]HitBeep[/b] - Select the sound made when hitting a target. Choose between:
[list][*] Off (no sound)
[*] Damage Based (sound based on how much damage was dealt)
[*] Single Sfx (play the base hit sound regardless of damage dealt)[/list]
[/list][h2]New Anti-Cheat[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have added anti-tamper security methods and have taken actions to significantly reduce in-game cheating and exploits. This added level of protection will continue to strengthen over time. 
[*] We recommend that any users experiencing issues disable third-party software while playing; in particular, any software that attempts to integrate with our game by creating overlays or performs keyboard or mouse automations. 
[list][*] Some GPU “tuning applications such as Riva Tuner or MSI AfterBurner may cause compatibility issues. If you experience gameplay issues, please disable these applications while playing.[/list]
[*] Test Signing is not supported. The game will not launch if Test Signing is enabled.
[/list]
[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
[b]All Maps[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 25th Anniversary flag banners to all maps
[/list]
[b]Awoken[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes to prevent Ranger from falling out of the map when using the Dire Orb too close to the hole in the Heavy Armor wall
[*] Removed unwanted totem placements outside the curved cooldown hallway
[/list]
[b]Blood Run[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the ability to place totems above the Heavy Armor teleporter entrance
[/list]
[b]Burial Chamber[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed unwanted totem placements in the Heavy Armor pit
[/list]
[b]Citadel[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the initial spawn locations in TDM
[/list]
[b]Corrupted Keep[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the staircase collision between the power-up and Mega Health 
[/list]
[b]Deep Embrace[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the medium & low Level-of-Detail meshes for the Heavy Armor wood planks, to prevent non-existent gaps from showing
[*] Additional fixes to the wood plank platform near Heavy Armor, to resolve hit collision between the planks on various settings of detail
[/list]
[b]Exile[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved collision on Power-up bridges, Mega Health ledge, Mega Health pit, staircase between Rocket Launcher and power-up, lower HMG teleporter entrance, above the vestibule doorway (across the Heavy Armor pit), and the Tri-bolt ledge
[*] Added additional respawn locations and reduced the cooldown on the existing respawn locations
[*] Removed the ability to place totems around the edges of the Heavy Armor pit, the edges of the Railgun pit, and behind the teleporters
[/list]
[b]Ruins of Sarnath[/b]

[/list]

[/list]

[h2]Duel Updates[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Quake Champions Winter 2020 Update
notes.content:
Winter has come, and it's brought a brand new Quake Champions update! This update includes our first ever ice-themed map, Exile; and a CTF version of The Longest Yard! There are even more presents under the Quakemas tree with new game modes, Season 9 Battle Pass rewards, and tons of balance updates!

[h1]UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]

[h1]NEW MAP: EXILE[/h1]
[i]"Only the dust-laden ice holds together these halls at the end of time. Only the jaundiced traces of their sole denizen etch and illuminate their walls."[/i]

The icy arena Exile lies within The Rift, the dark edge of the Dreamland where the Elder God known as The Lurching King now resides. Exile is available in Duel, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Clan Arena, Instagib, Unholy Trinity, and Hot Rockets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/b636935bdd0c6530d1aede11be50e123fb5d9187.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW MAP: THE LONGEST YARD CTF[/h1]
A remix on the classic, this mirrored teamplay version of The Longest Yard is now available in Capture the Flag mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/93ca0afb98222904748b99ace5b6345f9b499cbc.jpg[/img]

[h1]SEASON 9 BATTLE PASS REWARDS[/h1]
Pick up this Season's Battle Pass and unwrap some festive rewards:
[list]
[*] 55 winter vanities
[*] 107 new profile icons
[*] Returning weapons: MARAUDER, GRAVEDIGGER, FLINTLOCK, and TESLA
[*] 6 new Lore scrolls, "The Music in the Darkness," which when fully collected unlocks the MASTER SHADER for the Lightning Gun and Railgun
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/47df1e9e2c32469c4cac91c4a56eab3070975358.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW STORE OFFERS[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]SHAMBLER ARM Lightning Gun[/b] — To Ranger’s pleasant surprise this glistening clawed limb, torn from fresh slaughter, still keeps a charge.
[*] [b]FREEZE GUN Super Nailgun[/b] — Available once more for a limited time, pelt your enemies with a barrage of snowballs with this winter themed SNG!
[*] [b]COUNTRY FLAGS 2[/b] — 114 new country flag profile icons
[*] [b]SALES[/b] — Outfits up to 70% off and Weapons up to 60% off
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/37f57be1f8ee229a7b90b1f169a646ae37c3b557.jpg[/img]

[h1]IN-GAME PRO LEAGUE REWARDS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quake Pro League title belts added for QPL Championship victors!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/a30e3fd1835a8ec2ba6cab40766cccb5c9257db4.jpg[/img]

[h1]CAPTURE THE FLAG[/h1]
[list]
[*] MercyLimit now only takes affect in Round 2
[*] Added scoring bonuses for killing the flag carrier(+1), retrieving the flag (+1), and capturing (+5)
[*] Added Flag Drag, causing Flag Carriers' maximum movement speed to be reduced to 80%. Movement below these reduced limits remain uninhibited. Examples:
[*] Ranger's top speed of 1000 ups reduced to 800 ups
[*] Crouchsliders /Air-Dodger's top speed of 750 ups reduced to 600 ups
[*] Anarki's top speed of 640 ups reduce to 512 ups
[*] Sorlag's top speed of 625 ups reduced to 500 ups
[/list]

[h1]DUEL[/h1]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards & Ranks reset!
[*] Minimum spawn radius increased from 35m to 42m
[/list]

[h1]TDM 2v2[/h1]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards & Ranks reset!
[/list]

[h1]AWOKEN[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed exploitative hiding spot outside the Mega Health window
[/list]

[h1]BLOOD COVENANT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added CTF support, now available in Quick Play, Practice, and Custom Game
[/list]

[h1]DEEP EMBRACE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed exploitative hiding spot outside the Rocket Launcher window
[*] Widened the jumppad trigger at the Rocket Launcher jumppad 
[*] Fixed two collision exploits
[*] Removed a thin collision ledge near the Rocket Launcher staircase health bubble
[*] Fixed collision at tri-bolt shards, rockets could be fired into the wall at shards
[/list]

[h1]RUINS OF SARNATH[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added CTF support, now available in Quick Play, Practice, and Custom Game
[/list]

[h1]CHAMPION MOVEMENT[/h1]
We now properly enforce maximum speed caps for Champions both in the air and on the ground. Previously, speed caps only applied to Champions on the ground, but they could indefinitely go beyond their speed cap if they remained airborne via Rocket Jumps. We now still allow such similar bursts of speed from RJs to initially go over their maximum speed, but now those characters will have their air speed degrade down to the intended speed cap. 

The largest impact of this change will be in CTF when some characters attempt to cross the map in seconds to either attack the flag, escape with the flag, or chase to retrieve the flag. In these situations you'll see that the Champions who can currently go above their intended max speed will now be somewhat kept in check.

[h1]CHAMPIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Anarki - Max speed 15.625 m/s (625 ups) to 16 m/s (640 ups)
[*] Athena - Max speed 50 m/s (2000 ups) to 25 m/s (1000 ups) 
[*] Clutch - Max speed 20 m/s (800 ups) to 17.5 m/s (750 ups)
[*] Slash - Max speed 20 m/s (800 ups) to 17.5 m/s (750 ups)
[*] Sorlag - Fixed the body banking (A/D and W/S) animations that would cause her torso to rapidly shift position when attempting to change horizontal direction. 
[*] Sorlag - Max speed 15 m/s (600 ups) to 15.625 m/s (625 ups)
[*] Strogg & Peeker - Max speed 20 m/s (800 ups) to 17.5 m/s (750 ups)
[/list]

[h1]WEAPONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Extended the max Railgun range from 150 m (6k u) to 250 m (10k u), necessary for the distances present on The Longest Yard CTF
[/list]

[h1]POST-GAME SCOREBOARD & STATISTICS UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed damage scoring system persistence to post-game scoreboards & summaries
[*] Added ability damage to post-game statistics tab! The damage stat will now show your combined weapon and ability damage dealt
[/list]

[h1]VANITY WEAPONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quake Pro League Title Belts added for QPL Championship victors!
[*] Toned down INCINERATOR Plasma Beam third-person FX
[*] Fixed the Moonstriker's muzzle offset
[/list]

[*] Active abilities disabled

[*] Spawn with Super Shotgun and infinite shells

[/list]
[h2]NEW SEASON 6 REWARDS[/h2]
1 New Outfit, 4 New Weapons, 5 returning Weapons, 3 New Spring Vanities, 13 returning Spring Vanities, and more!

Level 1 Premium - MONSOON Quake 4 Rocket Launcher

Level 2 Free - MARAUDER DOOM Eternal Super Shotgun

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/70b321eeaf662acadf387e2d84b9c550d824987f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/41600f91d8ea5d6161af2888818eafc410b93c21.png[/img]
[h1]NEW STORE ITEMS[/h1]
Show your support for the Quake Pro League with this new Outfit & Weapon shaders bundle![list][*] Themed in the colors of the Quake Pro League!
[*] 16 new outfits with included attachments
[*] 11 new weapon shaders
[*] All proceeds support the Quake Pro League!

[h1]IMPROVED SERVICES INFRASTRUCTURE[/h1]
[i]Bethesda.net BDK integration updated[/i]
[list][*] Now on the most current integration of the Bethesda.net services
[*] Resolves many issues which may cause some players to not be able to connect or maintain a connection (Error 1501 for example)
[/list]
[h1]OPTIMIZATIONS & PERFORMANCE UPDATES
[/h1][list][*] Significantly reduced the texture memory load on all quality settings
[/list]
[h1]PROFILE STATS[/h1][list][*] Time Played and Avg Lifetime stats fixed
[*] Battle Report and Post-match statistics screens will now no longer be skipped due to these stats overflowing
[/list]
[h1]CHAMPIONS[/h1]
[b]Light Champions[/b][list][*] +25 Staring Armor Points (in all modes excluding Duel)
[/list]
[b]Heavy Champions[/b][list][*] -25 Starting Armor Points (in all modes excluding Duel)
[/list]
[b]Anarki[/b][list][*] Decreased the volume of the Anarki first person jump and move hoverboard sounds
[/list]
[b]Death Knight[/b][list][*] Fixed fireballs so they now properly apply the DOT on impact
[*] Lowered the fireball damage from 25 to 20 each 
[*] Changed DK firetrails so that they no longer give a DOT, but instead give damage when standing on the trail. Trail damage is 10 pts every 1 sec standing on the trail.  Standing on more than one trail will result in 10 damage per trail
[/list]
[b]Slash[/b][list][*] Increased the volume of the third person crouch sliding sound effects
[/list]
[b]Sorlag[/b][list][*] Max speed cap reduced from 640 to 600 ups

notes.title: Quake Champions Fall Update - Now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/1eabed5186d76a152d80fdb3aabacb43aeb66029.jpg[/img]

[h1]GREETINGS CHAMPIONS,[/h1]
Our Fall Update is now LIVE with two new modes; new Battle Pass content; balance changes; bug fixes; and more! 

[h1]BUILD HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
[b]NEW RANKED SEASON[/b]
We’re kicking off the new season with a new ranked mode and a Leaderboard reset. Everyone begins Season 4 with a clean slate and can begin qualification matches on day 1, no need to level up before jumping into the fray. To test everyone’s skills, we’ve added Time Limit Duel to Ranked Play, which has been in the forefront since QuakeCon and the launch of the new Quake Pro League and Challenger Cups. 

Now is a great time to challenge yourself in Ranked Play, completed your qualification matches, and work your way up the Leaderboard. Participating in Ranked Play is a great way to improve your skills, challenge yourself, and eventually prove yourself – and hopefully have some fun along the way. :)

[b]How does Time Limit Duel work?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Objective.[/b] Choose 1 Champion, pre-selected prior to the match and are locked into place for the duration of play. Earn the most frags in 10-minutes, or first to twenty frags to win! If players are tied at the end of 10-minutes, players enter into Sudden Death and pressure mounts as the next frag leads to victory. 
[*] [b]In Custom Game[/b], TLD works just as you have come to know it. Two players in the Custom Game Lobby have an unlimited amount of time to make their Champion choices, with no restrictions. Players can increase the frag count, choose to disable abilities, or agreed to house rules for their Champion and map selections. Once the Party Leader is ready, they initiate the match and off you go!
[*] [b]In Ranked Play[/b], TLD is largely the same, but with one new twists – blind picks. Once you have been matched with an opponent, each player will be given 15 seconds to decide who they wish to play. There are no restrictions on who you get to play, and your choice is made in private. You may have a favorite Champion that you always wish to play, you may make a decision based on the map voted upon, or you may want to make a strategic choice by attempting to guess who your opponent may select if you happen to have know their playstyle. Once both players have locked in their selections, the Champion matchups are revealed in-game when you see the two Champions face-off before entering warm-up.
[*] We hope you enjoy this classic staple of Quake Duel.
[/list][h1]NEW SEASON REWARDS[/h1]Battle Pass Season 4 progression and rewards are now available, including:

[b]20 New Battle-Pass exclusive Rewards:[/b]
[list][*]3 Champion Vanities: RANGER SHAMBLER SPECTER, STROGG & PEEKER ASSIMILATOR, DEATH KNIGHT NOSFERATU
[*] 5 Fall Nameplates
[*] 1 Animated Nameplate
[*] 5 Fall Profile Icons
[*] 6 Volkerh Lore Scrolls, earn the complete set to unlock Volkerh Weapon Shaders
[/list]
[b]Additional Battle-pass Rewards:[/b]
10 Vanity Weapons, including:
[list][*] PUMMEL Gauntlet
[*] OSCILLATOR Nailgun
[*] CESS RIFLE Heavy Machinegun
[*] TRESPASSER Super Shotgun
[*] DISRUPTOR Super Nailgun 
[*] PURGATOR Tri-bolt
[*] MOONSTRIKER Rocket Launcher
[*] CONDUCTOR Lightning Gun
[*] VIOLATOR Railgun
[*] GRAVEDIGGER Machinegun[/list]
2 Seasonal Vanities:
[list][*] SLASH MISS KITTY KAT
[*] SLASH KAT MASQUERADE[/list]
[*] 6 Volkerh themed Profile Icons
[*] 750 Platinum
[*] 132 Shards
[*] 20 Reliquaries, each contains 3 items, with at least one item of legendary quality
[*] 1 XP Booster
[*] Bonus Progression beyond Level 100, players can earn an additional 10 Reliquaries and 100 Shards.
[/list][h1]NEW VANITY ITEM: RANGER SHAMBLER SPECTER[/h1]These phantom limbs haunt Ranger’s every move, flailing his mind and waiting for him to drop his guard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/59de956a8150d2c0a9ca354bb8659ebd9ac80f65.jpg[/img]
[h1]NEW VANITY ITEM: STROGG & PEEKER ASSIMILATOR[/h1]Designed for massive assaults on population centers, the Assimilator set was equipped with all the tools necessary to induce the Stroggifcation process, leaving victims writhing in the streets for deployed Technicians to add them to the hive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/26e7f5d265eeb746d1e1b91591b5d93fe631f791.jpg[/img]
[h1]NEW VANITY ITEM: DEATH KNIGHT NOSFERATU[/h1]Even the creature of the night are prey to the Ash King.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30423540/eb899d583eba005e8507b4901e45dd97b2bce247.jpg[/img]
[h1]NEW MODE: CLASSIC FFA[/h1]We’ve added a new game mode to Quick Play, a classic take on Free-For-All where Ranger has found himself trapped in a nightmare from when he had first entered the Dreamlands. With the all-mother Shub still up to no good and no Dire Orb at his disposal, Ranger only has his trusty Gauntlet and Machinegun at his side, along with any weapons he can add to his arsenal along his way.
[list]
[*] Ranger-only Deathmatch
[*] Spawn with Gauntlet, Machinegun, 125/100 HP, 0/100 AP
[*] No spawn protection
[*] Slower weapon respawn
[*] On death, players drop weapon but do not drop shards
[/list][h1]GAME MODE UPDATES[/h1]
[b]ALL (applicable) [/b][list]
[*] Removed 2 second delay on ending Sudden Death. This would allowed additional score changes after the sudden death requirement was met, leaving the match with odd and undesirable ranking results
[/list][b]DUEL (Rounds and Timelimit)[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowered the chat position when the scoreboard is displayed[/list]
[b]SLIPGATE is now ATTACK and DEFEND[/b]
[list]
[*] Spawn with Overmax Health
[*] Spawn with Overmax Armor
[*] Disabled self-damage
[*] Disabled health, armor, and ammo spawns
[*] Scorelimit raised from 5 to 7
[/list]
[b]SACRIFICE[/b]
[list]
[*] Capture time increased from 90 to 120 seconds
[/list]
[b]UNHOLY TRINITY[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed Power-Up spawning – Could return in future updates, but for this season we’re going to try UHT without power-ups!
[/list]
[b]PRACTICE TDM (Bot Matches)[/b]
[list]
[*] Added The Longest Yard to Bot TDM map voting pool [/list][h1]SOUND UPDATES
[/h1]
[b]Overview (Stereo & Surround)
[/b][list]
[*] Improved directional positioning 
[*] Reduced volume of ambient sounds
[*] Updates & fixes to reduce sound cutting out when a large number of sounds were playing
[*] Reduced the volume of teammates and weapon fire not directed at you, to help you isolate and target the enemies that are immediate threats
[*] Unified character sounds to a 32m (1280 u) sound radius. Most of these sounds had a radius of 37.5m (1500 u) but varied. As a comparison for those familiar with our previous titles, the max sound distance in Quake Live is 1250u.
[*] Unified and reduced weapon firing and explosion sounds from 70m (2800 u) to 45m (1800 u) radius. 
[*] Added player respawn sounds audible within a 20m (800 u) radius
[*] Added third-person weapon switching sound events, you can now hear enemies switch weapons within a 20m (800 u) radius
[*] Fixed BJ-Duel Wield sounds
[*] Fixed Tri-bolt Quad sound
[*] Added ~250 new VO lines, increasing the diversity but not frequency of VO
[/list][b]HRTF 3D Positional Sound (Beta)
[/b]Improvements and fixes made to the HRTF Beta, but is currently only recommended for matches with small player counts, such as Duel. 
Want to try HRTF 3D Positional Sound? Be sure to check the following:
[list]
[*] Set in-game Speaker Configuration to Stereo
[*] Enable HRTF before you play, HRTF can only be enabled or disabled in Settings while not in-game
[*] You must be using Stereo Headphones. Special headphones are not needed, you can use anything from Ear Buds to Studio Monitor Headphones, but headphones that have Surround Sound features should have those features disabled or they would not be recommended.
[*] Spatial Sound in windows should be set to (Off)
[*] Disable any other Windows or audio driver level Surround Sound simulations or environmental effects
[/list][h1]Changes & Fixes[/h1][b]Hit Boxes[/b][list]
[*] Increased the radius of the existing Torso Capsule to 0.4m (16u) for all Champions, giving a consistent center mass hitbox. Arms, legs, and head hit volumes still exist as additional hit areas
[/list][b]Play Now UI[/b]
[list]
[*] New Deathmatch Icon
[/list][b]Scoreboard UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Kill/Death Ratio to all non-Duel Scoreboards
[*] We no longer show your player at the top of your team’s scoreboard regardless of placement
[/list][b]Leaderboard UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the unused Season dropdown
[/list][b]Player Profile UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the unused Achievement tab
[/list][b]Control Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Zoom Sensitivty to use auto-scaling focal length sensitivity
[*] Added ‘Auto-Scale Zoom Sensitivity’ option. Recommend and enabled by default, this will apply focal length scaling to your mouse sensitivity while zoomed. When disabled, there is no auto-zoom scaling and the Zoom Sensitivity Multiplier will be applied directly to your mouse sensitivity, allowing you more control over your zoom sens.
[*] Updated Control Settings layout to support new options, keep weapon and movement binds “above the fold” and position the often adjusted mouse sensitivity values closer to the Save button
[*] Added greater precision to the Mouse Sensitivity, Pitch, Yaw, Mouse Accel, Mouse Accel Offset, Mouse Accel Sensitivity Cap, and Zoom Sensitivity Multiplier sliders
[/list][b]Audio Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] We now show values on the Audio Sliders
[*] Added two classic Quake Live Kill Beep options: Bell and ChaChing
[/list][b]Upgraded to the latest Bethesda.net SDK[/b]
[list]
[*] The latest bnet infrastructure to minimize errors generated from our legacy implementation[/list][b]Localization[/b][list]
[*] Misc fixes, including various typos in champion descriptions, challenges, removed gender-specific references from medals, genarlized obelisk medals to be inclusive of CTF events
[/list][h1]Champions[/h1]
[b]All Champions[/b]
Air Acceleration / Strafing Updates: strafing will now feel like previous Quake titles.[list]
[*] Light’s accel increased 0.85 to 1.0
[*] Medium’s accel increased 0.9057232 to 1.065557*
[*] Heavy’s accel increased 0.9671111 to 1.137778
[/list]
*Exception of Visor, who’s Passive grants him the base speed and air accel of a light Champion

[b]Anarki[/b]
[list]
[*] Hoverboard becomes silent after Anarki has remained still for a short period of time[/list]

[b]Death Knight[/b]
[list]
[*] Flame Wall lifetime increased from 3 to 5 seconds [/list]

[b]Eisen[/b]
[list]

notes.title: August PTS Update #3
notes.content:
UPDATE 8/16: We've now deployed PTS Update #3! See below for full notes.

Hey Quakers! The latest PTS update is now LIVE! 

Please note that this build is not representative of the final build coming in the next official Live Build update. There may be further features added/removed/shifted as well as additional PTS builds to test these. Also, the patch notes below will always be abridged versions compared to the Live Build. [b]Understanding this is paramount. [/b]

[h1]How do I get the PTS?[/h1]
On Steam, in your Library, you should now have what looks like a whole new listing for a game called “Quake Champions PTS” that should be right under “Quake Champions” in your list of games.

If you don’t see the “Quake Champions PTS” as above, try this: From within the Steam Client, go to the Quake Champions Store page. Just above the Play Game button there should be a blue box that says "Want to participate in the Quake Champions Public Test Server? Click here to install it now." Click there, and it should add PTS to your Steam Library. If you still can't find it or have any additional issues, please contact one of our lovely CS team and they can sort you out: https://help.bethesda.net/

Now onto the notes!

[h1]August PTS Update #3[/h1]
[h1]Time Limit Duel Lobby[/h1]
[list]
[*] We now Show and Hide the Champion Select Confirm Button during the appropriate phases of the Ranked Blind Pick
[*] Champion Roster now appropriately shows your selected Champion after you’ve made your confirmation
[/list]
[h1]Sound Updates[/h1]
[b]Please test both HRTF and non-HRTF, and if possible use Stereo Headphones when HRTF is enabled.[/b]
[h1]Map Pools[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added The Longest Yard to Bot TDM map voting pool
[/list]
[h1]Hit Boxes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the radius of the existing Center to Chest Capsule from x to 0.4m (16u) for all Champions, giving a consistent center mass hitbox. Arms, legs, head hit volumes still exist as additional hit areas.
[/list]
[h1]Lightning Gun[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced LG width radius 0.12 to 0.0625m (4.8 to 2.5u)
[/list]
[h1]Rocket Launcher[/h1]
[list]
[*] Restored some RL splash min distance for max splash from 0 to 8u (live is 12u) aka “how far away from the hitbox can you land a rocket and still receive max splash damage”
[/list]

[h1]Previous Update #2 Notes[/h1]
[h1]Time Limit Duel Lobby
[/h1][list]
[*] Blind Pick Process now only occurs in Ranked MM (Custom Game is like live behavior, both players have unlimited time to pick before party owner starts the match.)
[*] Blind Pick Process now informs you when it is your turn or the enemies turn to pick.
[*] Main Menu Nav is no longer locked while queueing Time Limit Duel
[*] Queue Time Limit Duel now places the player into a Lobby while queuing
[*] Score Limit in Ranked set to 20 Frags
[/list]
[h1]Classic FFA (Added in August PTS Update #1)[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a Ranger-only Deathmatch
[*] Abilities disabled
[*] Spawn with Gauntlet, Machinegun, 125/100 HP, 0/100 AP
[*] On death, players drop weapon but do not drop shards
[/list]
[h1]Sound Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Please test both HRTF and non-HRTF, and if possible use Stereo Headphones when HRTF is enabled.
[*] Known Issues:
[list][*] High weapon of weapons may occasionally drop or crackle in HRTF when there are a large number of sound events (most often with 4+ players). This will be addressed in the next build.[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Scoreboard UI
[/h1][list]
[*] Added Kill/Death Ratio to all non-Duel Scoreboards
[*] We no longer show your player at the top of your team’s scoreboard regardless of placement.
[/list]
[h1]Settings UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Game & Control Settings layout
[/list]

[h1]Champions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Air Acceleration / Strafing Updates Strafing will now feel like previous Quake titles.
[*] Light’s accel increased 0.85 to 1.0
[*] Medium’s accel increased 0.9057232 to 1.065557*
[*] Heavy’s accel increased 0.9671111 to 1.137778
[*] Fixed DK’s speedcap, was temporarily capped at 15 m/s (600 ups), restored to normal 50 m/s cap (2000 ups)
[/list]
* Visor’s Passive will be improved in subsequent updates

[b]Death Knight[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed DK’s speedcap, was temporarily capped at 15 m/s (600 ups), restored to normal 50 m/s cap (2000 ups)
[/list][b]Keel[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased Grenade Bounce coefficient from 0.35 to 0.5
[/list][b]Sorlag[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced spit velocity from 25 to 20 m/s (1000 to 800 ups), reducing the max range it can be spat.
[/list][b]Strogg & Peeker[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a short Q4-style Crouchslide Passive ability
[/list]

notes.title: June Patch Update 13.06.19
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Champions![/h1]

Today's update includes the brand new mode: [b]Time Limit Duel[/b], a new season of Free & Premium [b]Battle Pass[/b], champion and weapon balance changes and a ton of new QoL updates including a bunch of cool new toggle options in main menu for community-requested features like switch weapon on empty; low health warning; and show damage indicator; just to name a few.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/3bb04cf296b94c5b449a7df5f2f3ee2d441b072f.png[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/4cd04c20fb2302d095edfe86963f329399fd6b6c.png[/img]


[b]New Game Mode: TIME LIMIT DUEL[/b]
Available only in Custom Game, [b]Time Limit Duel[/b] is a a roundless, time limit-based duel mode. Players select one Champion in the Custom Game Lobby before the match and fight for dominance until time has elapsed.

[b]Battle Pass – Season 3[/b]
Season 3 progression and rewards available, including: 
- 	4 New Champion Vanities (see below)
- 	1 New Summertime Outfit for B.J. Blazkowicz (see below)
- 	14 new Profile Icons
-	  17 new Nameplates 
-	  6 Goroth Lore Scrolls, earn the complete set to unlock Goroth Weapon Shaders
-	  775 Platinum
-	  113 Shards of Progression
-	  70 Shards on Weekly Challenges
-	  6 Reliquaries
-	  1 XP Booster
-	  Extended Progression. Players who complete the Battle Pass at Level 100 unlock additional levels!

[b]NEW VANITY ITEM: SCALEBEARER MILITARY ISSUE GUARD[/b]
Titanium enforced and ready for heavy combat.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/5a139efcfadef9db9478394a2c859ad2a1bd7a17.png[/img]

[b]NEW VANITY ITEM: EISEN ELECTROWELD
[/b]
High-powered, portable welding kit. It even works in a vacuum and in zero-g environments.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/7c387bbed0948c52541076adb3ecf5d8ecda8f9d.png[/img]

 [b]NEW VANITY ITEM: DEATH KNIGHT CABAL IKON[/b]
Those who forged him protected this weapon with intense jealousy. He took the IKON with him after he tore through their flesh.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/c006dad6ba988b4a3ac980814132aa400b630793.png[/img]

 [b]NEW VANITY ITEM: NYX BLUE ANGEL[/b]
Many myths still surround phantom energy, chief among them its origins. It is theorized that when Ghost Walk is activated, a hole in reality is opened to somewhere else. But where?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/f012992f142d8f75e3b09f61a69aa62de2f724c5.png[/img]

[b]NEW SUMMERTIME OUTFIT FOR B.J. BLAZKOWICZ[/b]
There's no better way to spend a hot summer day than at the beach. BJ is ready for some R&R.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/0668a42e5c41fc794e557e455a5545ea1256cd5e.png[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life Updates[/h1]
-	Switch on Empty: Choose whether the weapon auto-switches away when attempting to fire without ammo
-	Show Damage Indicator: Choose to enable/disable the radial UI element on the HUD that shows the direction of incoming damage
-	Taking Damage Warning: Choose to enable/disable the sound effect that plays every time you receive damage. When disabled, your champion pain sounds become your primary audio cue for damage received
-	Low Health Warning: Choose to enable/disable the sound effect that plays when you reach 25 hp or below
- Low Health Heavy Breathing: Choose to enable/disable the Heavy Breathing VO that plays when a champion is 25 hp & below
-	Champion VO Quips: Control the frequency of the Champion Quips on Frag, Assist, Respawn, and Critical Health voice overs. 0 = off, 0.5 = 50% of the time, 1.0 = always play
- Kill Beep: Control the sound effect played when killing a player to Off/Default/Ding


[h1]New Weapons available for Shards[/h1]
-	Joining last Seasons additions of the Ebony & Ivory Shotguns, the EXTERMINATOR Railgun has been added

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/4f52c146d1cae3c9a40000c771af503892f5fc24.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/40e7715ef04131d601b027234640b64f22850884.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/c562ade6b1fd403d7403db991e089fa9affcb0f5.png[/img]

-	Bots now strafe jump for higher skilled bots
-	Bots now randomize outfits and vanities and use the full array of names that were available in Custom Game when multiple bots of the same Champion type were added
-	Item pick-ups are disabled in warm-up during the pre-game countdown
-	Reduced, by default, how often your Champion plays a voice over quips by 50%
-	Critical Health VO: Added 3 new VO lines for each Champion. When a Champion falls below 25 HP, they can play one of these quips to let you know that you are critically low on health and should heal up.
-	Removed Breakables in Ranked Modes
-	In 2v2 TDM, reduced maximum respawn time from 15 to 10 seconds
-	Existing users accounts will now have to abide by our name filters. In the event that your name is no longer allowed by the most recent filters, you will be prompted to rename on login. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/d8ac7c6da2c4cf112e1eb803120f767051679b20.png[/img]

[b]Anarki[/b]
-	Shooting & zooming delay after Injection increased 0.4 to 1.0 sec
-	Max speed decreased from 680 to 625 ups
-	Injection Speed Boost reduced from 816 to 700 ups 
-	Friction 8 to 6
-	Ordinal Acceleration 15 to 10
-	Wishspeed from 35 to 30
-	Circle Strafe Friction 12 to 8

[b]Clutch[/b]
- Barrier Shield Protection reduced 50 to 40%
-	Health Decay Rate reduced from 1 to 2 seconds (1 pt every 2 seconds)
-	Movement collision box reduced from 48u to 40u
-	Weapon Fire Delay after ability removed
-	Reduced hitbox size

[b]Keel[/b]
-	Splash Damage Reduction increased from 10 to 15%
-	Health Decay Rate reduced from 1 to 2 seconds (1 pt every 2 seconds)
-	Reduced hitbox size

[b]Scalebearer[/b]
-	Health Decay Rate reduced from 1 to 2 seconds (1 pt every 2 seconds)
-	Reduced hitbox size
-	Weapon Fire Delay after ability reduced from 0.4 to 0.2 sec

[b]Sorlag[/b]
-	Health Decay Rate reduced from 1 to 2 seconds (1 pt every 2 seconds)
-	Max speed decreased from 680 to 640 ups
-	Friction 8 to 6
-	Ordinal Acceleration 15 to 10
-	Wishspeed from 35 to 30
-	Circle Strafe Friction 12 to 8
-	Movement collision box reduced from 48u to 40u
-	Reduced hitbox size

[b]Strogg & Peeker[/b]
-	Stroyent Cells now give 5% cooldown, in addition to healing

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/5f295367da1143fd86386f6e314b136e3d36ebcf.png[/img]

[b]Starting Machinegun[/b]
-	Damage 9 to 8

[b]Shotgun[/b]
-	Pellets “18 Pellets x 5 dmg = 90 Damage” to “20 Pellets x 4 dmg = 80 Damage”
-	Pattern: “2 Rings of 9” to “2 Rings of 10”
-	Pellet Knockback 1.25 to 2 
-	Total Knockback 22.5 to 40

[b]Super Shotgun[/b]
-	Pellets “28 Pellets x 5 dmg = 140 Damage” to “30 Pellets x 4 dmg = 120 Damage”
-	Pattern “3 Rings of 9 plus 1 Centered Pellet” to “3 Rings of 10”
-	Pellet Knockback 2.75 to 2
-	Total Knockback 77 to 60

[b]Nailgun and Super Nailgun[/b]
-	Nail Radius 0.1 to 0 m

[b]Rocket Launcher[/b]
-	Direct Ground Enemy Knockback 100 to 90
-	Direct Air Enemy Knockback 110 to 90
-	Splash Ground Enemy Knockback 110 to 90
-	Splash Air Enemy Knockback 121 to 90
-	Note: Self Knockback not affected

[b]Lightning Gun[/b]
-	Ground Knockback 8.4 to 8
-	Air Knockback 10.8 to 10

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

-	Fixed the Stuck on Loading Screen Bug – The game client could crash and get stuck in an internal loading screen following a match, most frequently seen following Slipgate matches
-	Fixed the Daily Challenge Reroll Bug – The game client could get into a bad UI state if the player rerolled a challenge and receive a duplicate of another Daily Challenge they have already completed. This would prevent them from playing until the Daily Challenges recycle.
-	Fixed memory leak found with Tri-bolt projectiles
-	Reduced how far dropped items are tossed from dead players; players were getting denied their earned power-ups when killing carriers because the power-up would toss out so far in random directions.
-	Duel scoreboards no longer reveal important enemy pickup information (HP earned, MH pickups, medals, xp earned hidden)
-	Reduce Nail Size. This change makes nails points like our rockets so that they can pass through grates and aren’t quite as easy to land.
-	Fixed Galena’s Totem HUD UI, which would sometimes show more than the max 3 totems
-	Fixed the ability overlay (ex. Nyx blue screen fx, Doom Slayer red screen fx) were broken when players were using FXAA antialiasing
-	Match Time added to Death UI HUDs in all modes
-	The Contact list is now alphabetized to help players quickly locate their friends and followers
-	Contact searches will no longer return banned accounts
-	Added Crosshair Scale, Swear Filter, Audio Soundtrack, and this updates new batch of client options to your cloud settings so that they will migrate with you to new machines like our previous settings
-	Fixed an issue that could cause your autoJump to become disabled on the backend
-	Removed an outdated Clutch loading screen tip
-	Reported backtick in ENEMY`S PICK fixed to ENEMY'S PICK

notes.title: March Patch Update 21.03.19
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Champions,[/h1]

Today’s update includes Custom Game + PTS access free to all players, a new season of Free & Premium Battle Pass, lots of QoL updates (smarter bots in more modes now with abilities, custom crosshair size, soundtrack selection support), daily login rewards, twitch drops, and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/4cd04c20fb2302d095edfe86963f329399fd6b6c.png[/img]

[h1]Performance Optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*] Server Networking Improvements
[*] Client Rendering Improvements
[*] Map Optimizations[/list]

[h1]Free Custom Game
[/h1][list][*] Custom Game for all Players
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/876b9c26c9b2f22fab4914764ea2cfa94d8474db.png[/img]

[h1]New Rewards and Store Offerings[/h1]
Season 2 progression and rewards available, including:

[list]
[*] 2 New Vanity Weapons: Flintlock Shotgun and Tesla Lightning Gun (see below)
[*] 6 New Champion Vanities (See Below)
[/list]
[b]NEW VANITY WEAPON: FLINTLOCK SHOTGUN[/b]
Sold at an auction, this unique flintlock shotgun was obtained at an estate sale in Virginia. The locals only knew him as Old Man Walter, uncertain if he had any living family.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/e8ae24e9438320acd73c83f82f3c406283946121.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW VANITY WEAPON: TESLA LIGHTNING GUN[/b]
A miracle of science and engineering, Dr. Tillinghast crafted this curiosity with no ill-intentions, he was merely fascinated as to whether it could be done.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/9a961c8cb1f3748c1f80fdf78a5bf359cfd1be5e.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW VANITY ITEM: ATHENA’S QUEEN OF THE SKY[/b]

These otherworldly wings were unlike anything Athena had ever seen, and she accepted them with great pride.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/ed7e2d0e7f55daee6c3c11cc4edd65ed8355446e.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW VANITY ITEM: CLUTCH’S TURBOCHARGER[/b]

Clutch is unstoppable once he dons this high-powered Turbo. It dials up the power to 11 and beyond.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/9a50e359d7d7ca0504174d2e1b2c617289be26ed.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW VANITY ITEM: DEATH KNIGHT’S EYE OF Y’RMEMAE[/b]

Death Knight ripped the Eye from the dying god’s form as its body dissolved into ash. He only wanted the Eye; the rest was useless to him.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/da055e5f75f82c7f2c70fb6481d817623b7b0624.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW VANITY ITEM: KEEL’S LASER TRIANGULATOR[/b]

Enemies won’t get far while the Laser Triangulator has them marked.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/8318d109a4cc4a0a76783e428b1b690008773c34.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW VANITY ITEM: SORLAG’S DRAKAENA[/b]

These are the spoils of a Sorlag’s first solo hunt, where she proved her ability to thrive outside of the brood.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/def431793e1e05478655a721ba6bdc92d38eb77b.jpg[/img]

NEW VANITY ITEM: VISOR’S PLASMA EMISSIONS SYSTEM

This system was designed to vent Visor’s excess heat, by converting it to dispersed plasma runoff.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/d518b87ae4165a4074cf2b7dafb91f3f177ceeb9.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW STORE FEATURE: CHIBI ICON PACK[/b]

Created by community artist Xous54

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/d0ac4d04814360b62321250443035ea8be7e9df4.jpg[/img]

There’s only so much room for Chibi Champions in one image… But we didn’t forget Visor #SaveTheBestForLast

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/6395a7091711be503c864662113bd1db786393ff.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Learn section
[*] Slipgate & Sacrifice Return
[*] Expanded Humans vs Bot Modes
[*] Bot Improvements, including Abilities
[*] Crosshair Size
[*] Soundtrack Selection support, and the return of Chris Vrenna’s Soundtrack
[*] Champion Balance, including a reworking of Clutch’s Barrier Shield
[/list]
[h1]Twitch Drops[/h1]
[list]
[*] Drops are re-enabled once again, now dropping Shards and Reliquaries
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/c562ade6b1fd403d7403db991e089fa9affcb0f5.png[/img]

[h1]Tech & Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues on the server, where UDP sockets could be blocking and not send all of the packet data during a network update
[*] Decreased the cost of rendering features, such as particles, to improve FPS consistency in busy combat
[*] Removed hundreds of MBs of unused UI assets, this will help lower video memory consumption and improve load times
[*] Fixed an issue where a player’s settings would be set to Ultra instead of Medium when the system specs were not detected
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when selecting a Champion’s artifact and clicking on Lore Codex on the Progression screen
[*] Fixed a rare infinite loading screen and crash players could encounter while leaving a match.
[*] Fixed an issue where gore pieces would twitch
[*] Fixed players becoming stuck on loading screen while the match begins in the background
[*] Fixed an issue where a player’s Profile Champion will replace selected Champion while waiting in a matchmaking lobby
[*] Fixed an issue where players would return to the Main Menu instead of back to Custom Game after completing a match with 1 human player
[/list]

[h1]Client Launch[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced logo parade down from 4 scenes to 1 to shorten the loading sequence
[*] Intro Cinematic now plays once on first launch, then auto-defaults off. Can be re-enabled in Video Settings
[/list]
[h1]Daily Login Rewards[/h1]
[list]
[*] Daily Login Rewards return, players may now login daily to earn Shards, XP, Platinum, and Reliquaries
[/list]
[h1]Onboarding[/h1]
[list]
[*] New players may now earn Scalebearer and Nyx through the tutorial Starting Challenges
[*] New players must now complete one Humans vs Bots TDM match before unlocking the remaining Practice and Quick Play modes at Level 2
[/list]
[h1]Main Menu[/h1]
[list]
[*] New slimmer “Q” HOME button
[*] Added a LEARN section to the main nav
[*] Updated Store Icon
[*] Added a Battle Pass section to the main nav
[*] Updated Watch icon
[*] Removed the Battle Pass button that was located below Customization
[*] Added a Confirmation Popup when purchasing locked Champions directly from the Main Menu
[*] Fixed an issue where models on Main Menu would appear in low res after a match ends
[*] The Free Champion Rotation now features 2 or more Champions each week.
[/list]
[h1]Learn[/h1]
[list]
[*] Basics
[*] Movement Introductions and Tutorials
[*] Weapon & Item Stats
[*] Progression Info
[*] Matchmaking & Ranking Info
[/list]
[h1]Store[/h1]
[list]
[*] Store updated with new sections: Outfits and Weapons
[*] Weapons and Outfits can now be purchased for full price directly in Customization, items featured in the Store are on discount
[*] We have removed the Loot Box and XP Booster sections, and placed those items into Bundles
[*] Replaced the previous real-money-transaction Champions Pack with a platinum purchase Quake Pack as a means to obtain all Champions
[*] Added a Battle Pass token
[*] Added new Chibi Icon Pack featuring artwork by community artist Xous54
[*] XP Boosters increased from a +25% to +200% bonus
[*] Discounted the price of Reliquary 10-pack by 50% from 4000 to 2000 platinum. Great value for new players who would like to unlock vanity weapons and outfits. A 10-pack yields 30 items, with 10 guaranteed legendaries.
[*] Reduced price of 7-Day XP Boosters from 400 to 300 platinum
[*] Reduced price of Rename Tokens from 1500 to 1000 platinum
[*] Fixed an issue where “Maximum Amount Reached” would appear when hovering over a purchase button
[*] Fixed an issue where player would see a negative number for the price when unlocking a Champion
[/list]
[h1]Battle Pass[/h1]
[list]
[*] Season 2 Added! New rewards, including the Flintlock Shotgun, Visor Plasma Emissions System, and the Tesla Lightning Gun.
[*] Rewards are now auto-granted at the end of a match upon leveling instead of requiring a physical claim on the Battle Pass; collect button is only available if items are available to collect
[*] Total XP to complete Season 2’s Level 100 reduced to 55% of Season 1’s requirements
[*] Added a DAYS REMAINING counter
[*] Added quantity numbers to thumbnails along the path for platinum and shard rewards
[/list]

UPDATE: Maintenance is complete, servers are now LIVE!

[h1]HEY QUAKERS,[/h1]

At [b]10:00 EST/14:00 GMT today[/b], [b]Tuesday, February 26[/b], there will be a brief maintenance as reorganize the datacenter selection menu to better illustrate which geographical regions each datacenter serves, and we will be spooling down servers that split population regions. ASPAC-North
ASPAC-Central
ASPAC-South
SA

Look forward to our next performance update coming in March, and we’ll see you in the Arena!

notes.title: New XP scoring system
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/081fa3b0a3a0b7a1c87b33bfd9c836df12c071ef.png[/img]

Hello Quakers!

We've revamped the XP scoring system to strongly reward players for participation and performance in a match, and substantially decrease the amount of XP for idling in matches.

Here are some of the changes we've made:

[list]
[*] Increased Kills from 3 to 100
[*] Increased Assists 1 to 50
[*] Increased Medals 7-35 to 10-50
[*] Increased 1st Place 35 to 500
[*] Increased 2nd Place 17 to 250
[*] Increased 3rd Place 7 to 100
[*] Increased MVP 17 to 50
[*] Decreased Match Completion 1120 to 50
[*] Decreased First Game 700 to 250
[*] Decreased First Win 1400 to 250
[/list]

This will lower the average earned XP for idle/afk players from 1500-2000 to about 350-500. Active players, depending on their performance, should earn an average of 2k-8k XP per match; significantly more than what was on the live build. This should help players get over the progression hump they have experienced near Level 35.

We’ve also greatly increased the Custom Game XP output to nearly match Live Public games for [b]Kill, Assist and Medal bonuses[/b]. However, we of course removed the bonuses for Match Completion, First Game, First Win. So now players who over index in Custom Game matches with friends or practicing with bots will now earn a proper amount of XP towards their BattlePass goals.

These changes are live [i][b]right now[/b][/i]!

Enjoy, and thanks for all your constructive feedback around the XP system!

notes.title: Performance Patch January 2019
notes.content:
Happy New Year, Quakers!

We are releasing a performance update this morning at 10:00 EST / 15:00 UTC that should address performance issues some players may have experienced since the December Update:

[list]
[*] If you’re on LOW or MEDIUM settings in the main menu, the menu uses MEDIUM texture settings ( otherwise, it’s based on your settings ). This will help min spec players that reported very high memory usage and long load times.
[*] In-game, texture quality for all things in the world will now obey the users texture settings ( ex: if you have your settings to LOW, then champions, weapons, the world itself, etc. should all use LOW texture quality ). This will help min spec players with 2 GB video cards, and overall performance.
[list][*] To get the most benefit out of setting everything to LOW, you should set your Video Resolution to 720, and turn OFF Gore.[/list]
[/list]
Estimated time until the servers are back up: 13:00 ET / 18:00 UTC. 

Thanks Quakers!

notes.title: December Update: Status and Upcoming Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey Quakefriends and fam,

Yesterday we released our December Update which included major new changes including a revamped and improved rewards system, the long-awaited Capture the Flag mode, and many balance changes and quality of life additions. There were also some unfortunate bugs that slipped down the chimney in this build; we’ve got them on our “Naughty” list and we will be releasing a hotfix soon that should hopefully address these issues:

[h1]Matchmaking Issues - RESOLVED[/h1]

Following the update, players may have experienced some issues with the in-game matchmaking. Earlier today we conducted maintenance that corrected these issues.

[h1]“Processing Transaction” timeout issue[/h1]

In this update, we’ve shifted away from random rewards with clearer Champion Progression and free Rewards systems, and the all new Battle Pass with exclusive rewards. We’re happy to hear that many of our fans are excited about these changes, and we are looking into the “Processing Transaction” issue that some players may have experienced. We’re investigating some possible solutions to the problem, and we are evaluating them for potential release in this hotfix.

[h1]Memory Usage and Performance issues[/h1]

We identified a memory bloat issue that is affecting some users who have 8GB of RAM in their system. (The minimum amount required to play Quake Champions.) Players may have noticed their RAM usage spiking during play; we are also targeting releasing a fix for this issue in this hotfix. Along with our improvements in diversifying Low, Medium, and High gameplay settings, users operating at the minimum spec should hopefully see some improvements in performance.  

As always, we will continue to optimize performance for a wide range of systems and PC configurations. With your help, we’ll continue to dive deeper into areas where we can make improvements. After the hotfix is deployed, try setting [b]ALL [/b]of your settings to Low with a resolution of 720p, and make a note of your [i]in-map[/i] performance. 

If you are still experiencing performance issues after the hotfix and after following these steps, we ask that you please post as many details as possible via the December Issue Megathread we will create in the forums [i][b]after the hotfix is deployed.[/b][/i] We ask that you post as many details of your experience as possible along with your in-game username, PC specs (CPU, GPU, RAM), and your in-game settings. Thanks!

[h1]December Update Message of the Day - RESOLVED
[/h1]
Some of you may have been so excited with the arrival of Capture the Flag mode that you hopped into game immediately without viewing the Patch Notes. We’ve added a brief reminder to the in-game Message of the Day that you can find all the answers to your questions about this update’s changes in the notes! 

Thanks again for all your patience, Quakers. We’re hurrying like elves to get this hotfix out as soon as possible so all of you can have a fragtastic Merry Quakemas! We will continue to update you regularly on the status of the hotfix.

notes.title: Patch Notes - December Update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/e04d0579b5925977d94b1ae945e46cb67a5ce065.png[/img]

[h1]Greetings Champions,[/h1]

We’ll be deploying an update on 20.12.2018 that includes a new mode: Capture the Flag (CTF), a new map: Citadel, a brand new Free & Premium Battle Pass System with an all new Champion Progression System, a fresh rotation of weekly Arcade Modes, a few Champion + Weapon Balance Changes and more granular graphic setting changes. We estimate the update process will take from 8AM EST – 2PM EST (11AM GMT to 6PM GMT).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/54dd6358c8d351cf27e135bc1fbcc8f50684ab6d.png[/img]

[h1]New Mode: Capture the Flag[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/71843b27c7df25722d86ac362227fedefbf968ef.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Two teams face off in a match of Capture the Flag
[*] Steal your enemy’s flag and return it to your base to score a capture
[*] Your team’s flag needs to be in your base in order to capture
[*] A match is divided into two halves, with teams switching sides of the map at halftime
[*] The team with the most captures at the end of the match wins
[*] If teams are tied at the end of the match, the team that has the most XP is the winner
[*] Supported Maps: Burial Chamber, Church of Azathoth, Citadel, Lockbox, Tempest Shrine
[/list]
[h1]New Map: Citadel[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/30da345ac07bc3f47fc423fa3efcd40d7530687e.png[/img]
Inspired by the popular Quake Live CTF map Stonekeep, we’ve been baking this one in PTS for a while now because we knew that we couldn’t release CTF without the perfect map for the mode: Citadel. This is our most symmetrical map yet, and as such is divided into two halves, Red & Blue with two power-ups spawning in the perimeters of each half! We hope you’ll love the new digs and are looking forward to seeing how you and your new team comps can creatively traverse this new addition to the dreamlands!

[h1]Free Rewards System and Premium Battle Pass[/h1]

We’re stoked to introduce our new free Rewards System and Battle Pass which rewards players for leveling up through their normal play and through daily + weekly challenges. There’s a ton of excellent content here, including this massively cool all-new vanity weapon at level 100:

[h1]New Vanity Weapon: Gravedigger[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/283e1191fffc8ae3003279147280cf28d19de47a.jpg[/img]
Excavated from an unmarked grave just outside Terlingua, a small Texas ghost town, this ornate fully automatic perplexed assessors. Too advanced for its age and forged from metals of unknown origin.

More details on the new free Rewards System and the Battle Pass: 
https://youtu.be/0-7klmtac6I
The in-game economy is going through some positive changes to accommodate for this new progression system. Here’s a shortlist of note:
[list]
[*] Favor removed
[*] Backpacks no longer for sale
[*] Chests no longer for sale
[*] Reliquaries guarantee 1 Legendary item
[*] Reliquaries sold in quantities of 1, 3, 10
[*] Reliquary discounts: qty 3 10% off, qty 10 20% off
[*] Left over loot boxes of all types may still be opened
[*] Duplicate rates have been extremely reduced in Backpacks, Chest, and Reliquaries
[*] Can no longer dismantle items in Customization
[*] Players earn Shards in Battle Pass and Weekly Challenges
[*] Champions unlocked for Shards (20 shards)
[*] Champion Progression points 1 Shard each
[/list]
Have more questions? We've got you covered with this handy [url=https://quake.bethesda.net/en/news/OUFBlFVmw002kmgAACiYe]FAQ[/url]!

[h1]Champion Progression System
[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/592c0151fa4c228309f063c31d505d112e7845a2.png[/img]
We’re very happy to finally unveil our brand new Champion Progression System which allows players to have agency over where and how they spend their Shards as every Champion has a linear level progression system. It includes everything from shaders, attachments, lore scrolls and full armor sets; including each Champion’s Elite Mastery Shader + Legendary Set. Rewards have never been clearer or as fun to obtain!

[h1]Performance Optimization
[/h1]

Performance improvements including:
[list]
[*] Particle optimization
[*] Texture resolution optimization
[*] Updated all video settings for low and medium for various settings
[*] Improved performance drops seen with Quad Damage
[*] Optimized Gore performance
[*] Frametime optimizations
[/list]
[b]Graphic Options Settings
[/b][list]
[*] More granularity on Graphic Settings (You’ll notice a much larger difference in texture quality/fidelity between Low -> Ultra settings in-game)
[*] Note: The Main Menu itself is locked a higher setting so don’t judge performance until in a match
[*] Pro Tip: If you have a <3gb GPU - please select Low Settings and you should notice less hitching and a smoother frame rates
[*] Let us know about your in-game performance experiences (esp. PCs with lower specs!) in the forums and please include your system specs and in-game name when you do! (Having your in-game name is [i][b]VERY [/b][/i]important!)
[/list]
[h1]Quality of Life Updates[/h1]

[b]Sound Update[/b]
[list]
[*] We reduced the volume of map ambient sounds on all maps by half for a more enjoyable gameplay experience (This was huge for us as we know it’s been one of the most-requested community asks!)
[/list]
[h1]December Playlist Update[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/051127bf52a8038644dc7b470fbaa0ed8a3b2967.png[/img]
November’s Playlist remix gave us a ton of good data on what people love playing the most, so we’re mixing it up again with what modes will be available.

[b]Quick Play Modes
[/b][list]
[*] CTF
[*] TDM
[*] DM
[*] Instagib
[*] Unholy Trinity
[/list]
[b]Ranked Modes[/b]
[list]
[*] Duel
[/list]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Instagib and Unholy Trinity have been moved from Arcade to Quick Play to improve MM times by allowing players to multi-select them alongside the core Quick Play modes
[*] Slipgate and Sacrifice has been removed from Quick Play and Arcade due to a remaining bug that we’re working on, but it will remain in Custom Game
Game Mode Unlocks
[*] New players will now have immediate access to Quick Play and Arcade, rather than unlocking individual modes as they level-up.
[*] Ranked play remains locked until Level 10
[*] In Battle Pass Season 1, all players are reset to Level 1, Ranked SR is reset, players must reach Level 10 before they can unlock Ranked, and players must play qualifier matches to become Ranked
[*] In future Seasons, while players will be reset to Level 1, they will not be forced to reach Level 10 to unlock Ranked Modes[/list]
[b]Bot Support[/b]
[list][*]Bots will only be present in Match Making lobbies for teams with an average ELO of 1300 & below who are experience long queue times.
[*]Bots will now only backfill players leaving in team modes and will no longer backfill in Free-For-All based modes.[/list]
[h1]New Arcade Modes[/h1]
A brand new way to queue up and play! The Arcade is a weekly rotation of rule modifiers that shake up how you play Quake Champions in fun, different ways. This month we’re introducing two new ones:

[b]AAArena[/b]
[list]
[*] BJ only. Infinite Ammo. LG only. Ability available on respawn. AAAAAAhhhhhHHHHHH!
[/list]
[b]Slide and Slash[/b]
[list]
[*] Slash and gauntlet only, trails insta-kill. Ability available on respawn
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/7f2c616021ced9c609d378f25d5f9e4f27d4fbcd.png[/img]

[/list]
[b]Clutch[/b]

[/list]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]
