[h1]We'll see you in the arena, Quakers![/h1]

notes.title: Champion Progression and New Ways to Earn Rewards in the December Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/d742648aa41bf8e6780fe990dd75b8dc3fd3cefb.jpg[/img]

Hey Quakers!

We're excited to announce some major changes to the progression system of Quake Champions coming in our December Update. We're taking the randomness out of rewards: Backpacks, Chests, Runes, and random Lore scroll drops--they're all [b]GOING AWAY![/b] 

When the December Update hits, players will be greeted with brand new ways to earn rewards just by playing the game and completing Daily and Weekly Challenges:
[list]
[*] The new [b]Champion Progression System[/b] lets you choose which Champions you unlock new items for--and the system is linear, so you know exactly [i]what[/i] you're unlocking [i]when[/i] you unlock it. No more hoping and wishing you get what you want out of that Backpack!

[*]We are introducing [b]a totally new rewards system[/b] that gives players a free path to rewards as well as an optional paid “Battle Pass” that unlocks even more, exclusive items. Earn XP and level up to unlock [i]100 tiers of rewards[/i], including many items new to Quake Champions!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/83147d752355c5690ffa61d9366940eb6093d276.jpg[/img]

As excited as you are right now, we know you've probably got questions. Check out this handy article for full details and FAQ (plus a pretty snazzy video with a look at all this new content): [url=https://beth.games/2E46REr]https://beth.games/2E46REr [/url]

We're eager to hear what you think, and you can look forward to clearer rewards and new goodies later this month!

notes.title: Latest Quake Champions patch nerfs all damage dealing abilities
notes.content:
Quake Champions' latest update signals a new rotation of weekly Arcade Modes, plus "a ton of Champion and weapon balance changes". The changes include nerfing every damage dealing ability and dropping the Max AP and Overmax AP of Heavy Champions from 150 to 125, and 225 to 200 respectively.

Conversely, Light Champions get a little boost as their Max AP has increased from 50 to 75, and their Overmax AP from 125 to 150.

As well as reducing the amount of damage, all cooldowns now last 45 seconds and you'll also find that triggering active abilities will now disable shooting for 500ms. Explosion radiuses have all been set to 3m, and explosion minimum splash damage "unified to 10".

Read more…

notes.title: November Update 17.11.18
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/f5d8db007016848f5d0f0019c5cd09b263e4e8b2.jpg[/img]

GREETINGS CHAMPIONS,

Our November Update is now LIVE! This update includes a new Champion: [b]Eisen[/b]; a ton of [b]Champion + Weapon balance changes[/b]; a fresh rotation of weekly [b]Arcade modes[/b]; and [b]map performance optimization[/b]. 

[h1]Build Highlights[/h1]

[b]Limited-time Event! Choose a Side: Team Eisen vs. Team Clutch![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/d70876e5426bee1bff535796e9196660620f499c.jpg[/img]

In this special event running [b]November 17-30[/b], Choose a Side splits the Quake Champions roster into two factions – Team Eisen and Team Clutch. As you play matches, each frag you score adds to that Champion’s respective team. [b]The full roster of Champions is unlocked for the entirety of the event for F2P players![/b] At the end of each week, players will receive their prize based on the side with the most frags. Full details [url=https://quake.bethesda.net/en/news/3zBJ6ZoMPYiS2wSQoWU8kk]here[/url].

[b]New Champion: Eisen[/b]

Even as a starship captain who’s seen more than his fair share of struggles, nothing could prepare Eisen for the bloodshed caused when the Clutch AI turned homicidal against its human masters – killing Eisen’s closest friends and loved ones in the process.

https://youtu.be/LLu3izM96Xc
Now hunting down the rogue robot through the Dreamlands, Eisen utilizes his special ability – the Sentry Turret – to watch his back. Once deployed, the Sentry Turret can alert Eisen of an enemy’s presence and fire off warning shots as a deterrent. While useful in keeping a step ahead of his foes, Eisen’s Turret focuses on [i]utility[/i] over raw damage and is susceptible to enemy fire, so be mindful where you place it!

[b]Starting Statistics:[/b]

Health 125/100
Armor 50/100
Speed 310

Active Ability: SENTRY TURRET - Places an automated turret that tracks enemies and fires hyperblaster laser bolts

Passives: 
REPURPOSE - Reduce ability time cooldown by 10% when collecting Light Armors
SALVAGE - Reduce ability time cooldown by 20% when collecting Heavy Armor

[b]Esports Invitational Bundle[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/48823fe7e40a1989f1ed9dbb521980fc71f56b03.png[/img]

Starting next week - get ready to start support Quake Esports with the Invitational Bundle! Available for a limited time, and comes with Quake 3 Plasmagun, 200 Platinum, 2 Reliquaries, and 7 Day XP boost. Allows unlimited purchases!

[b]November Playlist Update[/b]

UNHOLY TRINITY & HOT ROCKETS return all month long in the Arcade Playlist! Alongside them, NEW arcade modes will continue to rotate weekly. (Listed below.) Also, for all Sacrifice lovers, we’re adding Sac back to the November Quick Play! #SacIsBack

[b]Instagib Classic[/b]
Visor-only, no abilities

[b]Insta Mystery[/b]
Random Champions, Active & Passive abilities deal insta-damage

[b]Mystery Sacrifice[/b]
Utilize the random champions you receive to capture and defend the obelisks

[b]Map Performance Optimization[/b]
Improved game performance on the following maps:

[list][*]Corrupted Keep
[*]Lockbox
[*]Longest Yard[/list]

[b]New Feature: Post-match Victory Animations[/b]

On post-match podiums you’ll notice that Champions now have new individual victory animations. More to come on this in upcoming updates…

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES:[/h1]
[list][*]Added Weapon Position game option, allowing players to force all weapons to the center or right of the screen, or choose to keep them at their vanity weapon defaults
[*]Bot combat logic improved
[*]Added two additional tiers of bot difficulty[/list]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]

Unified weapon ammo pick-up behaviors between modes, so the behavior you experience in FFA is also now present in Duel
[list][*]Now all weapons will fill you to their starting pickup value if you are low on ammo. If you have the starting ammo value or greater for a weapon and you pick-up the gun again, it will only grant you +1 for low rate of fire weapons or +10 for high rate of fire weapons.[/list]

[b]Power-ups[/b]
All power-ups, in all modes, now initially spawn at 90 sec and then respawn every 2 minutes afterwards. (Doing away with inconsistent rules between game modes. - - Previously power-ups spawned at 45 sec in Sacrifice, 80 sec in Slipgate, and 120 sec in DM/TDM.)

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[*]Fixed Enemy Outline ‘ON’ option
[*]Fixed Enemy Outline Color options to correctly apply the chosen color to the arrow, outline, and Fresnel lighting
[*]Fixed dropdown menus persisting when pressing ESC to exit the Settings menu
[*]Fixed Resolution Scaling affecting names and clickables in multiple Menus
[*]Fixed text being cut off by text fields[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue where match wouldn't load properly for players that were spectating[/list]
[b]Tech[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a crash after player became stuck in infinite loading screen after match
[*]Fixed issue where Enable Voice Chat, Enable Gore, Show Hit Markers, and [*]Enable Speedometer settings were not saved on game relaunch
[*]Fixed mouse becoming unresponsive in full screen
[*]Fixed AFK Timer for viewers of streams in the Watch browser[/list]
[b]Localization[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue where Announcer VO is spoken in English in non-English languages[/list]
[b]Bots[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bots crashing in Sacrifice
[*]Attacking teammate bots will now close the Slipgate after all defending team members are killed
[*]Bots no longer fall off the map in Longest Yard
[*]On Longest Yard, Bots are now able to take the jump pad from the Tri-Bolt platform

[h1]Have fun, Quakers![/h1]

notes.title: October Game Update LIVE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/980bd9b221b191395a59d039781e2509af93e06d.png[/img]

[h1]GREETINGS CHAMPIONS![/h1]
The October Game Update is now LIVE! This update includes a new mode: Slipgate; a new Champion: Athena; a fresh rotation of weekly Arcade Modes; the Quake 4 Heavy Machinegun Vanity Skin “Annihilator”; Champion & Weapon Balance Changes; and a Game Hardening Pass (performance gains).

[h1]BUILD HIGHLIGHTS:[/h1]
[b]New Mode: SLIPGATE[/b]

https://youtu.be/9IN5spGwE1Y
Slipgate is an attack-and-defend mode where both teams fight over the Slipgate portal: a massive wormhole capable of summoning an ancient unnamed horror. Each-and-every sharpshooter spawns with all weapons, full health, full armor but a single, precious, precious life. The defending team of Elder God cultists are trying to open the Slipgate, while the attacking team must [b][i]stand on the point[/i][/b] to close the gate before whatever tentacled terror on the other side pulls itself into our dimension!

[b]LIMITED TIME EVENT: SLIPGATE FESTIVAL[/b]

https://youtu.be/8NM3ng8URjw
From [b]October 11th - 31st[/b] all players taking part from day one will immediately receive the [b]Elder Guardian Tentacle Weapon Shaders[/b] for all starting weapons (Machinegun, Shotgun, & Nailgun)! 

Subsequent festival milestones will result in the new [b]Annihilator Heavy Machine Gun Skin[/b] being gifted to all participants, then unlocking the [b]Overseer Scalebearer Lore Skin[/b] and, ultimately, [b]Athena[/b] – or her [b]Coalition Lore Skin[/b] if the Champion is already owned either through the Champions Pack, or by purchasing Athena any time before the goal is reached.

Read more about the Slipgate Festival [url=https://quake.bethesda.net/en/news/2s0R6Vl5hG4iySKakSEuyY]here[/url].

[b]New Champion: ATHENA[/b]

https://youtu.be/aLnyZiXc1i0
Athena was among the first to sign up to the GDF and seek vengeance against the Strogg who devastated Earth. Caught in a trap laid for the expeditionary forces, she escaped when a Slipgate generator collapsed, teleporting her drop pod into the Dreamland arenas. Now she uses her grapple line throws and aerial acrobatics to dominate the airspace above her enemies and rain death from above.

[b]Starting Statistics:[/b]
[list][*]Health 125/100
[*]Armor 0/50
[*]Speed 320[/list] 
[b]Active Ability – Grappling Hook:[/b] Athena will launch a grappling hook to the target location and immediately pull herself towards it. While in flight, Athena can stop pulling herself and instead swing, allowing her to perform impressive maneuvers:
[list][*]Linear Pull Hook
[*]Swing Hook
[*]Piercing Damage 25
[*]Swing Damage 50[/list]
[b]Passive Ability – Ramp Jump:[/b] Athena can reach great heights by using the top ramp or step as a launching platform.

[h1]Arcade Modes[/h1]

A brand new way to queue up and play! The Arcade is a weekly rotation of rule modifiers that shake up how you play Quake Champions in fun, different ways. This month we’re introducing four new modes, one for each week of the month (in order of appearance):

[b]UNHOLY TRINITY TDM[/b]
Choose any champion, all weapons have been removed from the map, however you spawn with the unholy trinity – Rocket Launcher, Railgun, & Lightning gun & NOW WITH A TEAM FULL OF FRIENDS! Armor and health are still present on the map. Practice your combos!

[b]LEAD THE WAY[/b]
Everybody’s Scalebearer in a Free For All Deathmatch where Bull Rush is an insta-kill on your enemies. So, basically, it’s an Insta Scaletrain to ChooChoo town!

[b]SWINGER PARTY[/b]
Put your keys in the bowl and… No, not THAT kind of party!!! Everybody’s Athena in a Free for All Deathmatch where a direct Grappling Hook shot on an enemy Athena is an insta-kill. So, basically, it’s a SWINGER’S PARTY.
( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

[b]SACRIFICE[/b]
Remember Sacrifice? Well, it’s that, but now w/ a shorter cap time - down from two-and-a-half minutes to just one minute!

[h1]New Weapon Skin: ANNIHILATOR[/h1]

Used on all galactic fronts, the SMC Annihilator is a space marine's best friend. It punches holes through enemies like they were paper. This Quake 4 Heavy Machine gun fits right into to any player's perfect arsenal.

[h1]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
In this update we’ve included a number of general improvements:

[b]Game Hardening:[/b] The team have taken a forensic look under the game’s hood in order to better deliver solid framerates and eradicate ‘ghost’ inputs as part of our ongoing commitment to improving the game’s performance.
Read the full details of our Game Hardening in our latest Dev Diary [url=https://quake.bethesda.net/en/news/58IZAK4qEwGkIa4esMYQIK]here[/url].

[b]Performance Summary[/b]
[list][*]Improved performance of FX heavy Champions
[*]Improved client and server-side performance for shotgun
[*]Improved performance of Gore spawns
[*]Improved performance of several maps through art/shader optimizations [*]and poly count reductions[/list]
[b]Quality Of Life Updates[/b]
[list][*]Added a HUD section to Game Settings
[*]Added Ally and Enemy Outline Color options in HUD Settings
[*]Added Current Challenge Info toggle in HUD Settings
[*]Added Zoom FOV options to Game Settings
[*]Reintroducing Scoreboard to End of Match – Thanks to your feedback, we brought this back from a lost Slipgate in the depths of the Dreamlands[/list]
[b]Champions[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Respawning via the pause menu with Slash could cause death camera to shake rapidly
[*]Fixed an issue with Strogg where player was unable to pick up the soul during Sacrifice after using Peeker
[*]Fixed an issue with Strogg where the 'Sensor Antenna' Vanity did not cloak properly upon ability use
[*]Fixed an issue where Ranger's Dire Orb could pass through doors[/list]
[b]Maps[/b]
[list][*]Addressed an issue on Longest Yard to improve Lighting on the pre/post game podium screens
[*]Fixed various art issues by the Heavy Machinegun spawns on Longest Yard
[*]Fixed an issue on Longest Yard where players could shoot and damage others through the floor
[*]Addressed an issue on Tempest Shrine where players could stand out of the playable area by the Ship
[*]Hourglass pick-ups adjusted to reduce how quickly active abilities can be restored, reducing the number of available hourglasses and/or moving them to positions that favor the player out of control.
[list][*]Awoken 5 to 6 (increased, but moved them from areas of power to areas of weakness)

[*][b]Blood Run[/b] 7 to 6
[*][b]Ruins of Sarnath[/b] 17 to 10
[*][b]Tempest Shrine[/b] 15 to 13
[*][b]The Molten Falls 9 to 7[/b][/list][/list]
[b]Map Changes: Lockbox[/b]
[list][*]Updated Lockbox item layout
[*]Swapped the locations of Mega Health and Power-Up
[*]Removed the Railgun near the floating platform in the Aeon Crystal room (upper toilet bowl)
[*]Swapped the locations of Lightning Gun and the nearby Light Armor
[*]Moved the Heavy Armor: In TDM/DM it is now located in the Blind Oculus room (Point B) - In Sacrifice / Slipgate it is in the cavernous staircase near the Blind Oculus
[*]In the Bridge Room: moved the Light Armor from behind the Acidfall to the center of the lower level
[*]Added a Teleporter behind the Acidfall that leads to the upper 3rd level of the same room
[*]Replaced the Super Nailgun on the 3rd floor of the Acidfall Bridge room with a Railgun
[*]Added two Small Healths near the Rocket Launcher
[*]In Sacrifice / Slipgate: repositioned the Heavy Machinegun in the closed base (Point A) to align with the nearby jumppad
[*]Added a new teleporter to Lockbox behind the acid-fall[/list]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue which occurred after using abilities which could break the increased damage from zooming in with the HMG
[*]Fixed an issue where Flame effect could appear on the gauntlet when not playing Death Knight
[*]Fixed an issue where weapon textures could appear low res
[*]Fixed an issue where weapon zoom would zoom in several times further than intended[/list]
[b]Vanity[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the historically incorrect US Flag on BJ’s Liberator set
[*]Fixed a texture error on Sorlag’s Savage set
[*]Removed a reversed decal from the Pummel Gauntlet[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Players could appear in the lobby after disconnecting from a Custom match
[*]Fixed an issue where the Player profile would appear blank when opened
[*]Fixed an issue where the Time limit and score limit on the scoreboard were shown incorrectly
[*]Addressed an issue where Users could not access their player profile
[*]Fixed certain strings that were not showing up correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where a box would appear when hovering over the Eradicator Weapon in the Store
[*]Updated the Battle Report, Match Achievements to show proper amount of digits
[*]Fixed issues where certain buttons were not easily selectable[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with Strogg where Players were unable to pick up the Soul after using Peeker, during a Sacrifice match
[*]Fixed an issue playing Unholy Trinity where Rocket Launcher God medals earned were not added to profile properly
[*]Fixed an issue in Unholy Trinity where the Rocket Launcher would play the near-empty audio when fired at all times
[*]Fixed an issue in Team Instagib where Certain Champions did not take self-damage
[*]Spawn Protection added to all Quick Play and Arcade Modes, for consistent behavior in all unranked play[/list]
[b]Tech[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a crash in spectator mode which could occur if player was in free cam between matches
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur if players were using voice chat during warmup
[*]Addressed an issue specific to AMD Vega machines which could crash on launch
[*]Fixed an issue where the game could crash when spamming the Death [*]Knight ability when joining a session in progress
[*]Addressed various forum reported FPS and Performance drops and hitches during matches
[*]Addressed various champion gore issues throughout matches on different maps[/list]
[b]Spectator[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Spectator would see an empty Respawn button after a player respawned during warmup[/list]
[b]Bots[/b]
[list][*]Made various improvements to bot navigation
[*]Improved weapon handling & difficulty[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h1]Champion Balance Changes[/h1]
[b]All Champions[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted View Heights to account for recent rescaling of player models - essentially this pass is updating all Champion in-game model sizes to reflect their hitbox changes that we have over many patches from Feburary to now
[*]Unified Crouch Speeds
[*]Light Champions increased from 80 to 160u
[*]Medium Champions increased from 77 to 160u
[*]Heavy Champions increased from 75 to 160u[/list]
*Slash’s changes noted below
**Scale = Model Scale + Hitbox
[b]Anarki[/b]
[list][*]Raised View Height 0.65 to 0.66m[/list]
[b]B.J. Blazkowicz[/b]
[list][*]Lowered View Height 0.58 to 0.56m[/list]
[b]Clutch[/b]
[list][*]Scale 1.175 to 1.15x
[*]Lowered View Height 0.68 to 0.58m
[*]Further Reduced Hitbox Size[/list]
[b]Death Knight[/b]
[list][*]Lowered View Height 0.555 to 0.52m
[*]Flame Strike direct damage 50 to 40
[*]Flame Strike splash damage 51 to 30
[*]Flame Strike radius 3 to 2m (120 to 80u)[/list]
[b]DOOM Slayer[/b]
[list][*]Lowered View Height 0.75 to 0.6m
[*]Hands Raise Time 0.3 to 0.4s[/list]
[b]Galena[/b]
[list][*]Scale 1.1 to 1.2x
[*]Lowered View Height 0.62 to 0.6m
[*]Further Increased Hitbox Size[/list]
[b]Keel[/b]
[list][*]Scale 1.15 to 1.22x
[*]Hitbox size reduced (had too much padding after scaling)[/list]
[b]Scalebearer[/b]
[list][*]Scale 1.15 to 1.175x
[*]Lowered View Height 0.65 to 0.64m
[*]Bull Rush Damages Adjusted from 50/75/100/150/200 to 75/100/125/150/200[/list]
[b]Slash[/b]
[list][*]Lowered View Height 0.78 to 0.6m
[*]Crouch Speed 85% to 50% (272 to 160u)
[*]Crouch Slide Friction 1.3 to 1.0[/list]
[b]Sorlag[/b]
[list][*]Scale 1.1 to 1.0x
[*]Lowered View Height 0.7 to 0.58m
[*]Bunny Hop Acceleration 0.02 to 0.05[/list]
[b]Strogg & Peeker[/b]
[list][*]Lowered View Height 0.58 to 0.56m[/list]
[h1]WEAPON BALANCE CHANGES:[/h1]
[b]Lightning Gun[/b]
[list][*]Cooldown 55 to 52ms (18 to 19 shots per second) resulting in a very slight DPS boost of 1 more hit per second[/list]
See you in Slipgate mode, Quakers! Have fun!

notes.title: September Game Update 06.09.18
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/130a0af704ffad572eee9c63ce8659f28cafa6c9.png[/img]

GREETINGS CHAMPIONS!

The September game update includes a new map: [i]Longest Yard[/i]; four new [b]Arcade Modes[/b]; Quake 2’s Super Shotgun Vanity Skin “Trespasser” (named by you, our community!); Champion & Weapon balance changes; and [b]performance improvements[/b]. 

[h1]BUILD HIGHLIGHTS:[/h1]

[b]New Map: Longest Yard[/b]
[i]Only the power of the Rune of Black Magic prevents the floating ruins of Volkerh’s tabernacle from tumbling into the Blind God’s oblivion-maw.[/i]

The classic bottomless space map returns! Beware railguns and ringouts in this open area map where jump pads propel you to new heights and distant floating islands.

[b]Arcade Modes[/b]
A brand new way to queue up and play! The Arcade is a weekly rotation of rule modifiers that shake up how you play Quake Champions in fun, different ways. This month we’re introducing four new modes, one for each week of the month (in order of appearance):

[list][*][b]Unholy Trinity - [/b] Holy Trinity weapons only: the Rocket Launcher, Railgun, and Lightning Gun! This is the only mode with [i]abilities disabled[/i].
[*][b]Hot Rockets -[/b] Rocket Launchers only! Your own rockets won’t hurt you (so rocket jump to your heart’s content), but they’ll do triple damage to your enemies!
[*][b]Mystery Champion -[/b]  Each time you respawn, you’ll come back to the Arena as a random Champion!
[*][b]Team Instagib -[/b] Now you can play this one shot, one kill mode with friends![/list]

[b]New Weapon Skin: "Trespasser"[/b]
[i]Like a Berserker bursting out of a monster closet, the pump-action QUAKE 2 Super Shotgun likes to get up close and personal to its target, only to obliterate it.[/i]

Our players suggested the name for this one based off the Quake 2 Berserker Strogg's famous voice line, and we just had to use it! 

[b]Bot Backfill support[/b]
Bots will now fill in when players leave during a match to prevent uneven games.

[b]Party Queuing for Deathmatch and Instagib[/b]
Want to frag your friends in free-for-all modes? Of course you do, and now you can! Players in parties can now queue up for Deathmatch and Instagib Quck Play modes. 

[h1]PERFORMANCE UPDATES:[/h1]
In this update we’ve included a number of performance improvements:

[list][*][b]Gore System improvements –[/b] Decreases performance spikes caused by players respawning
[*][b]Logic optimizations – [/b]Reduces performance spikes upon respawn; score events; entity creation & destruction; and increases FPS
[*][b]Particle and Sound Effects optimization -[/b] Reduces hitching issues[/list]

[h1]BALANCE CHANGES:[/h1]

[h1]Champion Balance changes[/h1]
[b]Anarki[/b]
[list][*]Cooldown 50 to 45 sec
[*]Disable Shoot Duration 1.35 to 0.75 sec[/list]
[b]BJ Blazkowicz[/b]
[list][*]Cooldown 40 to 45 sec
[*]Duration 7 to 5 sec
[*]MG Rate of Fire 1.6x to 1.5x
[*]LG Rate of Fire 1.6x to 1.45x[/list]
[b]Clutch[/b]
[list][*]Cooldown 35 to 40 sec
[*]Duration 7 to 5 sec
[*]Shield Hide Time 0.7 to 0.9 sec[/list]
[b]Death Knight[/b]
[list][*]Splash Bug Fix
[*]Added Splash Damage Falloff
[*]Cooldown 30 to 45 sec
[*]Duration 8 to 6 sec
[*]Flame Dot 10 to 5
[*]Added 10 Damage on Trail (Standing on fire deals damage, similar to standing on Slash’s Plasma Trail)[/list]
[b]Scalebearer[/b]
[list][*]Improved Bull Rush target detection
[*]Bull Rush Damage Reduction 0.5 to 0.66[/list]
[b]Slash[/b]
[list][*]Max Speed 18 to 50 m/s[/list]
[b]Sorlag[/b]
[list][*]Scale 1.15 to 1.1x
[*]Disable Shoot Duration 1.0 to 0.75 sec[/list]

[i]"Why does my performance drop in The Longest Yard?"[/i]
There is a known issue where performance may drop when the player is looking towards the central area of the map. A workaround is to lower graphics settings. This is intended to be fixed in a future update.

notes.title: An Important Message Regarding Red Shell
notes.content:
Quakers,

We have been experimenting with ways to help us grow the Quake community, and one way is to learn which of our advertisements and web content effectively bring new Quake players to the game. To be clear: our limited trial use of Red Shell in Quake Champions only gathers anonymous data, such as where new players are coming from or how many matches they played. This helps us work smarter to grow a stronger Quake community, built on players who will continue to play the game. The software does not collect any personal information.

That being said our players are our top priority. In response to your concerns, we’ve stopped collecting this data and will be removing the trial version of Red Shell from the game with a hotfix next week. We are still investigating how to use this technology in the future to help us grow and sustain Quake Champions moving forward. When/if we do add it back to the game, we’ll give everyone a heads up and explain what it is doing and how it is doing it, and any implementation will be compliant with our Privacy Policy and GDPR.

[h1]Update:[/h1] As of June 26, we have deployed a hotfix that removed Red Shell.

- The Quake team

[h1]Greetings Champions,[/h1]
We’ll be deploying an update on 26.04.2018 that includes the new duo Champion: Strogg & Peeker, a new map Awoken, a new Super Nailgun vanity weapon: the Disruptor, and many quality of life improvements.
We estimate the update process will take from 7AM EDT – 2PM EDT (11AM GMT to 6PM GMT).

[h1]Content[/h1]
[b]New Champion: Strogg & Peeker[/b] 
[*]  Ability Drone Strike: Strogg enters a camouflaged state and deploys his drone. He assumes control of the drone, which can fly around and shoot at players using its Hyperblaster. Using the ability again causes the drone to accelerate forward and detonate upon collision.
[*] Passive Stroyent Cell:  Gather Stroyent capsules from your corpses of his enemies that heal his wounds.

[b]New Map: Awoken[/b] 
[*]  In the vine-choked valleys beyond Zar’s templed terraces, a monument to the Queen of Ciphers looms over what remains of the Temple of Forgetting.
[*]  Available in all modes with the exception of Sacrifice!

[b]New Vanity Weapon:  Disruptor[/b]  
[*]  The QUAKE 3 Plasma Gun returns, upgrading your standard issue Super Nailgun with plasma nails that rapidly consume its energy… and your enemies.

[b]Features[/b]
[*]  Daily Login Rewards
[*]  Updated Welcome Screen

[*]  Optimized Weapon FX
[*]  Leaderboard Improvements

[h1]Champions[/h1]
[b]Overview[/b]

[*]  Preserved the uncapped max speeds for most Champions but applied speed caps for Champions with special movement mechanics – sacrificing their max speed in favor of maneuverability

notes.title: March Patch Update 15.03.18
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/5d6e3ca984f74e7834678156f1efbf2483031b6b.png[/img][h1]GREETINGS CHAMPIONS,[/h1]
We’ll be deploying an update on 15.03.2018 that includes a new Instagibmode, Ranked 2v2 Team Deathmatch mode, a bunch of Champion and weapon balance changes as well as a ton of new cosmetics for our Spring Celebration! We estimate the update process will take place from 10AM EST - 2PM EST (2PM GMT to 6PM GMT).

[h1]GAME MODE UPDATES[/h1]

[h1]NEW GAME MODE: INSTAGIB[/h1]
 Instagib is a fun, casual mode
In Instagib mode, every shot is a one-hit kill. Players start with the railgun and gauntlet, and there are no weapon, health, armor, or powerup pickups. Champions can use active and passive abilities, and cooldown hourglasses spawn on the map

[h1] Greetings Champions, [/h1]
We’ll be deploying an update on 25.01.2018 that includes: Phase 1 of our new hit detection system, many quality of life items and Champion balance changes. We estimate the update process will take place from 8AM EST - 3PM EST (1PM GMT to 8PM GMT).

[h1] New Hit Detection Integrated [/h1]
[b] Phase 1: [/b]  ([i] NOW LIVE[/i]) Weapon hits are now detected client-side on our new capsule based hit skeletons, validated server-side. More details in our upcoming Dev Diary video 

[b] Phase 2: [/b] ([i] TBD[/i]) Move Champion Ability hit detection to the new capsule skeletons 

[h1] Features [/h1]
-	Premium Weapon Shaders added
-	Private Messaging added
-	Voice chat voice activation added
-	3rd person spawn animations added
-	Champion Difficulty Visual Indicators added


[h1] Champions [/h1]
-	Fixed issue for Keel’s ability which caused FPS drops 
-	Fixed issue when sometimes DOOM Slayer was missing punch animations 


[h1] Champion Balance [/h1]

[h1] Anarki [/h1]

-	Max Armor 75 to 50 

[b]Injection[/b]

notes.title: Update Jan. 18: Fixes to issues coming in January update
notes.content:
[b]**Updated January 18**[/b]

Quakers, after careful evaluation of the hotfix planned for January 18, we have found that it isn't up to our standard of quality. Rather than release an unstable patch that could cause more problems for our players, we've decided to not release the hotfix today, and instead include the fixes as part of our January update, slated for next week.

We apologize again for the delay, but we hope you'll agree that taking time to release a solid update is the best option.

notes.title: Early Access Update - 14.12.17
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/706c1915e26803e9e1b5e5f44b025cea697ad922.png[/img]

[h1] Hey Quake Fans,[/h1] 

We'll be deploying an update for Quake Champions today that will take approximately 4 hours starting at 8AM EST – Noon EST. This is one of our biggest updates to date and adds KEEL as a new champion, the Vale of Pnath as a new Duel Map, Ranked Play, Custom Crosshairs, the Quake 4 Railgun, a ton of balance changes and much more! 

[h1] KEEL Story trailer[/h1] 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SEZLj3RFDio
Also, as soon as the update is completed, it will be the start of a Double XP weekend running until 18.12.17.

[h1]Winter Celebration Items[/h1] 
https://youtu.be/W_SsJUUKpMA

[h1]The Winter Holiday [/h1]has come to Quake Champions! Players who logs in during December and January will receive free rewards! We have a ton of new holiday items, all of which drop from Backpacks, Crates, and Reliquaries.
New Winter items include:
- 1 Winter 2017 Hat Vanity for each Champion
- 10 Winter Profile Icons
- 10 Winter Nameplates 
- 3 Winter 2017 animated Champion Shaders
- 3 Winter 2017 Weapon Shaders for each weapon 

[h1]Winter Hat Bundle[/h1] 
- This limited-time bundle gives you hats for EVERY Champion. Happy Holidays!

[h1]Premium Shader Bundle[/h1] 
- This bundle offers 3 new Premium Shaders for each weapon!
- Limited time Winter Theme for the Dimension of the Doomed maps, Burial Chamber and Corrupted Keep

[h1] New Champion[/h1] 
Welcome to the arena heavy weapons specialists Lance Corporal Ben Keel, or at least what’s left of him. Brought back to life thanks to cybernetics and power-armor, Keel is armed to the teeth with two shoulder mounted grenade launchers.

[h1] KEEL[/h1] 
RESURRECTED WAR-MACHINE
- Health 175
- Armor 50/125
- Speed 300/480

[h1] Active Ability:Grenade Swarm[/h1] 
Keel can store and fire up to 5 grenades at a time. Grenades will bounce off the environment, detonating a few seconds later and inflicting splash damage. Direct hits deal 75 damage per grenade. Each grenade refreshes on a 10-second cooldown. 

[h1] Passive Ability: Stockpile[/h1] 
Keel can reduce his ability cooldown by 5% by collecting any ammo box. 

[h1]New Arena[/h1]  [h1]VALE OF PNATH[/h1]

ITHAGNAL DUEL MAP
Deep within the Netherworld, past the Peaks of Thok, lies this tower of metal and stone. The vault ghouls whisper that the death-maze of sharp angles could only have been hewn from the solid granite by Koth, the Never-Seen Sleeper In Stone. Prepare yourself for the Vale of Pnath.

Designed for Duel and 2v2 TDM, Vale of Pnath is a highly vertical three atrium arena where players will fight for control of both weapons and stack, using the sounds of heavy metal doors to track their enemies movements. Vale provides fun, hectic, and fast paced action for 2 players, but is also available in Custom Game for Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch.

[h1] New Weapon[/h1] 
[h1] VIOLATOR[/h1] 

QUAKE 4 RAILGUN
From the weapons depot of Rhino Squad comes the Quake 4 railgun. Mathew Kane brought this beast of a gun back from Stroggos just so you can assess your aim down its scope. How many can you take down in a single shot?

[h1]Additional Features[/h1] 
- New Ranked Play and Leaderboards for Duel
- Added Crosshair Customization: one of the most requested Community features
- Choose from over 40 different crosshairs and use a slider to choose your color of choice 
- Chests & Reliquaries now offer guaranteed rarities!
- Chests reward at least one item of Rare quality and above
- Reliquaries reward at least one item of Epic quality and above
- Rune Challenge Animated Champion Shaders
- Each champion now has 5 new animated Champion Shaders which you can earn from completing one of four Elder God rune challenges, and the Master Rune challenge.
- Added FPS Limiter in Options
- Added Teammate X-ray Outlines Option
- Enabled load on demand of geometry for further memory optimization

[h1] Champion Balance[/h1] 
[h1] All Champions[/h1] 
- +25 Starting Health Points
- +25 Max Armor Points
- Champions will now gain some speed by holding forward (except Visor who is too stubborn and set in his ways)

[h1]Anarki[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups.
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 500 ups
- Max strafe speed has been reduced from 640 to 560 ups
- Injection speed duration increased from 3 to 10 seconds
- Injection speed boost increased from 1.1x to 1.25x (700 ups)

[h1]B.J. Blazkowicz[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 500 ups
- Dual-Wield rate of fire increased

[h1]Clutch[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration rate of gain increased, to reach its top speed of 500 ups faster
- Dodge now resets after each landing, instead of a timed cooldown

[h1]Doom Slayer[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups
- Berserk has a shorter range to lock onto target

[h1]Galena[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 300 to 400 ups
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed from 300 to 500 ups

[h1]Nyx[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 320 to 400 ups

[h1]Ranger[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 320 to 400 ups

[h1]Scalebearer[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 300 to 520 ups
- Scalebearer’s strafe max speed has been reduced from 500 to 480 ups

[h1]Slash[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups
- Max Crouchslide speed has been decreased from 680 to 600 ups

[h1]Sorlag[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 290 to 320 ups
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed of 290 to 500 ups

[h1]Visor[/h1] 
- Increased strafe acceleration, to build speed faster while strafe jumping
- Piercing Sight now highlights enemies fully in red, instead of just outlines

[h1]Champion Fixes[/h1]      
- Fixed issue in Crouch Slide when 1st-person hands animation and audio can remain stuck after slide is interrupted 
- Fixed issue when some champions may play ability animation and sound effects after their first ability timer had ended 
- Fixed issue when BJ: Crouch walk posture appears unnatural 
- Fixed issue for Clutch's Mining Laser secondary ability which stayed in the air if a player died while using it  
- Fixed issue when Clutch’s Dodge could fail if he touched the stairs 
- Fixed issued when Doom Slayer could hit with active ability while strafing backwards 
- Fixed issue for Doom Slayer: Activating Berserk while firing slower weapons delayed bringing up the fists 
- Fixed issue when champions could play active ability animation twice 
- Fixed issue when Ranger is able to teleport after Dire Orb has exploded 
- Fixed issue for Scalebearer ability animation which would break if activated right before landing from a jump 
- Fixed issue when Some attachments for BJ may disappear from the customization screen after a match

[h1]Champion Costumes[/h1] 
- Added "Executor" Scalebearer costume
- Added "Pack Lord" Sorlag costume

[h1]Item Balance[/h1] 
- Respawn times of minor items, Small Health and Light Armors, increased from 15 to 30 seconds

[h1]Weapon Balances[/h1] 
- Improved hit detection for Lightning Gun
- Decreased the range of the Gauntlet
- Decreased the rate of fire of the Gauntlet

[h1]Weapon Fixes[/h1] 
- Fixed issue when Gauntlet stopped spinning after each hit
- Gauntlet hit detection improvements 
- Fixed some occurrences where LG bloomed heavily 
- Fixed issue when shooting RG near the geometry resulted in missing rail SFX 
- Fixed issue when using scope on RG and switching to another weapon did not cancel RG charge 
- Fixed issue on DOOM  Shotgun for broken reload animations in first person
- Nailgun hit detection improvements
- Projectile prediction fixes (miss hits after knockbacks) 

[h1]Tech[/h1] 
- Fixed issue with incorrect resolution in borderless when trying to set 4k resolution 
- Fixed issue where Rate of Fire was impacted by FPS 
- Fixed issue where Voice Chat was triggered while typing in Match Chat 

[h1]Network Traffic Optimization[/h1] 
- Various Traffic Optimizations Made

[h1]Client Performance Improvements[/h1] 
- Client outgoing bandwidth optimization
- Player jitter fixes
- Spectator jitter on steps fixed
- Various Client Performance Improvements

[h1]Memory Optimization[/h1] 
- Reduced frequency of player coordinate calls

[h1]Crashes[/h1] 
- Fixed numerous crash issues

[h1]Maps[/h1] 
- New breakables for Cthalha maps  
- New breakables for Ithagnal maps
- Closed space around Pillar in Blood Covenant near Quad powerup allows for blind fire and Dire Orb travel to the space below.  
- Fixed issue when on Burial Chamber Dire Orb could fly for infinite amount of time  
- Fixed issue where players spawn facing wall on Lockbox  
- Fixed issue when portal on Lighthouse had no proper collision  
- Fixed issue when player was able to pierce level geometry with Dire Orb 
- Closed geometry holes in Church of Azathoth
- Fixed issue on Corrupted Keep where a player could get on top of the statues  
- Fixed issue in Ruins of Sarnath where breakables were missing in DM/TDM   
- Improved respawn on Blood Covenant  
- Corrupted Keep: Player can get on top of the head statues above mega  
- Urns can be broken with Gauntlet 
- Fixed issue when spectator saw post-match podium geometry 
- Fixed issue Blood Covenant: Ranger can toss his Dire Orb out a window and use it to teleport   later than intended 
- Fixed issue Blood Run: Cathedral Chamber: Players can get stuck on ledge near Heavy Armor 
- Fixed issue Blood Run: Railgun spawn point gives less ammo on pickup than other maps on both its first pickup and additional pickups 
- Fixed issue Tutorial: Heading for Heavy Armor tutorial reads "Light Armor." 
- Fixed issue Customization: Ranger's torso attachments disappear from the customization screen after a match  

[h1]UI[/h1] 
- Fixed issue where incorrect level showed in duels battle report 

[h1]Spawn System[/h1] 
- Fixed issue Ruins of Sarnath where Opposing Teams may spawn next to each other in Sacrifice Mode 
- Fixed issue in Church where Opposing Teams may spawn next to each other in Sacrifice Mode      

[h1]Razer Chroma[/h1] 
- Fixed ability fire and cooldown effect 
- Various Chroma effects added to gameplay events

[h1]Random drop[/h1] 
- Added Holiday mood loot box scene
- Fixed issues where Loot Box duplicated items were awarding inconsistent amount of Shards  
- Fixed issue when player did not see shards icon after receiving a duplicate  

[h1]Misc[/h1] 
- Fixed issue where Twitch stream didn't load when selected
- Addressed multiple instances of medals not being announced on the HUD  
- Fixed string that did not have localization when adding player to ignore list  
- Fixed issue in Customization where Users were unable to sell pieces of a Champion’s Costume or sets if they had Attachments unlocked on them  
- Fixed issue where Enemy and Ally Outline options did not revert back to default  
- Fixed issue when Australia and Norway flags were unavailable  

[h1]New Server Added[/h1] 
- Added new server in Mumbai that will provide a new coverage area between Frankfurt and Singapor

- This limited-time bundle gives you hats for EVERY Champion. Happy Holidays!

[h1]Premium Shader Bundle[/h1] 
- This bundle offers 3 new Premium Shaders for each weapon!
- Limited time Winter Theme for the Dimension of the Doomed maps, Burial Chamber and Corrupted Keep

[h1] New Champion[/h1] 
Welcome to the arena heavy weapons specialists Lance Corporal Ben Keel, or at least what’s left of him. Brought back to life thanks to cybernetics and power-armor, Keel is armed to the teeth with two shoulder mounted grenade launchers.

[h1] KEEL[/h1] 
RESURRECTED WAR-MACHINE
- Health 175
- Armor 50/125
- Speed 300/480

[h1] Active Ability:Grenade Swarm[/h1] 
Keel can store and fire up to 5 grenades at a time. Grenades will bounce off the environment, detonating a few seconds later and inflicting splash damage. Direct hits deal 75 damage per grenade. Each grenade refreshes on a 10-second cooldown. 

[h1] Passive Ability: Stockpile[/h1] 
Keel can reduce his ability cooldown by 5% by collecting any ammo box. 

[h1]New Arena[/h1]  [h1]VALE OF PNATH[/h1]

ITHAGNAL DUEL MAP
Deep within the Netherworld, past the Peaks of Thok, lies this tower of metal and stone. The vault ghouls whisper that the death-maze of sharp angles could only have been hewn from the solid granite by Koth, the Never-Seen Sleeper In Stone. Prepare yourself for the Vale of Pnath.

Designed for Duel and 2v2 TDM, Vale of Pnath is a highly vertical three atrium arena where players will fight for control of both weapons and stack, using the sounds of heavy metal doors to track their enemies movements. Vale provides fun, hectic, and fast paced action for 2 players, but is also available in Custom Game for Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch.

[h1] New Weapon[/h1] 
[h1] VIOLATOR[/h1] 

QUAKE 4 RAILGUN
From the weapons depot of Rhino Squad comes the Quake 4 railgun. Mathew Kane brought this beast of a gun back from Stroggos just so you can assess your aim down its scope. How many can you take down in a single shot?

[h1]Additional Features[/h1] 
- New Ranked Play and Leaderboards for Duel
- Added Crosshair Customization: one of the most requested Community features
- Choose from over 40 different crosshairs and use a slider to choose your color of choice 
- Chests & Reliquaries now offer guaranteed rarities!
- Chests reward at least one item of Rare quality and above
- Reliquaries reward at least one item of Epic quality and above
- Rune Challenge Animated Champion Shaders
- Each champion now has 5 new animated Champion Shaders which you can earn from completing one of four Elder God rune challenges, and the Master Rune challenge.
- Added FPS Limiter in Options
- Added Teammate X-ray Outlines Option
- Enabled load on demand of geometry for further memory optimization

[h1] Champion Balance[/h1] 
[h1] All Champions[/h1] 
- +25 Starting Health Points
- +25 Max Armor Points
- Champions will now gain some speed by holding forward (except Visor who is too stubborn and set in his ways)

[h1]Anarki[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups.
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 500 ups
- Max strafe speed has been reduced from 640 to 560 ups
- Injection speed duration increased from 3 to 10 seconds
- Injection speed boost increased from 1.1x to 1.25x (700 ups)

[h1]B.J. Blazkowicz[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 500 ups
- Dual-Wield rate of fire increased

[h1]Clutch[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration rate of gain increased, to reach its top speed of 500 ups faster
- Dodge now resets after each landing, instead of a timed cooldown

[h1]Doom Slayer[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups
- Berserk has a shorter range to lock onto target

[h1]Galena[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 300 to 400 ups
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed from 300 to 500 ups

[h1]Nyx[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 320 to 400 ups

[h1]Ranger[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 320 to 400 ups

[h1]Scalebearer[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 300 to 520 ups
- Scalebearer’s strafe max speed has been reduced from 500 to 480 ups

[h1]Slash[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 310 to 400 ups
- Max Crouchslide speed has been decreased from 680 to 600 ups

[h1]Sorlag[/h1] 
- Forward Acceleration added, increasing from the base speed of 290 to 320 ups
- Bunny Hop added, increasing from the base speed of 290 to 500 ups

[h1]Visor[/h1] 
- Increased strafe acceleration, to build speed faster while strafe jumping
- Piercing Sight now highlights enemies fully in red, instead of just outlines

[h1]Champion Fixes[/h1]      
- Fixed issue in Crouch Slide when 1st-person hands animation and audio can remain stuck after slide is interrupted 
- Fixed issue when some champions may play ability animation and sound effects after their first ability timer had ended 
- Fixed issue when BJ: Crouch walk posture appears unnatural 
- Fixed issue for Clutch's Mining Laser secondary ability which stayed in the air if a player died while using it  
- Fixed issue when Clutch’s Dodge could fail if he touched the stairs 
- Fixed issued when Doom Slayer could hit with active ability while strafing backwards 
- Fixed issue for Doom Slayer: Activating Berserk while firing slower weapons delayed bringing up the fists 
- Fixed issue when champions could play active ability animation twice 
- Fixed issue when Ranger is able to teleport after Dire Orb has exploded 
- Fixed issue for Scalebearer ability animation which would break if activated right before landing from a jump 
- Fixed issue when Some attachments for BJ may disappear from the customization screen after a match

[h1]Champion Costumes[/h1] 
- Added "Executor" Scalebearer costume
- Added "Pack Lord" Sorlag costume

[h1]Item Balance[/h1] 
- Respawn times of minor items, Small Health and Light Armors, increased from 15 to 30 seconds

[h1]Weapon Balances[/h1] 
- Improved hit detection for Lightning Gun
- Decreased the range of the Gauntlet
- Decreased the rate of fire of the Gauntlet

[h1]Weapon Fixes[/h1] 
- Fixed issue when Gauntlet stopped spinning after each hit
- Gauntlet hit detection improvements 
- Fixed some occurrences where LG bloomed heavily 
- Fixed issue when shooting RG near the geometry resulted in missing rail SFX 
- Fixed issue when using scope on RG and switching to another weapon did not cancel RG charge 
- Fixed issue on DOOM  Shotgun for broken reload animations in first person
- Nailgun hit detection improvements
- Projectile prediction fixes (miss hits after knockbacks) 

[h1]Tech[/h1] 
- Fixed issue with incorrect resolution in borderless when trying to set 4k resolution 
- Fixed issue where Rate of Fire was impacted by FPS 
- Fixed issue where Voice Chat was triggered while typing in Match Chat 

[h1]Network Traffic Optimization[/h1] 
- Various Traffic Optimizations Made

[h1]Client Performance Improvements[/h1] 
- Client outgoing bandwidth optimization
- Player jitter fixes
- Spectator jitter on steps fixed
- Various Client Performance Improvements

[h1]Memory Optimization[/h1] 
- Reduced frequency of player coordinate calls

[h1]Crashes[/h1] 
- Fixed numerous crash issues

[h1]Maps[/h1] 
- New breakables for Cthalha maps  
- New breakables for Ithagnal maps
- Closed space around Pillar in Blood Covenant near Quad powerup allows for blind fire and Dire Orb travel to the space below.  
- Fixed issue when on Burial Chamber Dire Orb could fly for infinite amount of time  
- Fixed issue where players spawn facing wall on Lockbox  
- Fixed issue when portal on Lighthouse had no proper collision  
- Fixed issue when player was able to pierce level geometry with Dire Orb 
- Closed geometry holes in Church of Azathoth
- Fixed issue on Corrupted Keep where a player could get on top of the statues  
- Fixed issue in Ruins of Sarnath where breakables were missing in DM/TDM   
- Improved respawn on Blood Covenant  
- Corrupted Keep: Player can get on top of the head statues above mega  
- Urns can be broken with Gauntlet 
- Fixed issue when spectator saw post-match podium geometry 
- Fixed issue Blood Covenant: Ranger can toss his Dire Orb out a window and use it to teleport   later than intended 
- Fixed issue Blood Run: Cathedral Chamber: Players can get stuck on ledge near Heavy Armor 
- Fixed issue Blood Run: Railgun spawn point gives less ammo on pickup than other maps on both its first pickup and additional pickups 
- Fixed issue Tutorial: Heading for Heavy Armor tutorial reads "Light Armor." 
- Fixed issue Customization: Ranger's torso attachments disappear from the customization screen after a match  

[h1]UI[/h1] 
- Fixed issue where incorrect level showed in duels battle report 

[h1]Spawn System[/h1] 
- Fixed issue Ruins of Sarnath where Opposing Teams may spawn next to each other in Sacrifice Mode 
- Fixed issue in Church where Opposing Teams may spawn next to each other in Sacrifice Mode      

[h1]Razer Chroma[/h1] 
- Fixed ability fire and cooldown effect 
- Various Chroma effects added to gameplay events

[h1]Random drop[/h1] 
- Added Holiday mood loot box scene
- Fixed issues where Loot Box duplicated items were awarding inconsistent amount of Shards  
- Fixed issue when player did not see shards icon after receiving a duplicate  

[h1]Misc[/h1] 
- Fixed issue where Twitch stream didn't load when selected
- Addressed multiple instances of medals not being announced on the HUD  
- Fixed string that did not have localization when adding player to ignore list  
- Fixed issue in Customization where Users were unable to sell pieces of a Champion’s Costume or sets if they had Attachments unlocked on them  
- Fixed issue where Enemy and Ally Outline options did not revert back to default  
- Fixed issue when Australia and Norway flags were unavailable  

[h1]New Server Added[/h1] 
- Added new server in Mumbai that will provide a new coverage area between Frankfurt and Singapor

notes.title: Hotfix and Double XP Week
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/82abd9b4eef7a11e0838a56bc48c09fb2d31abc2.png[/img]

Following our 5.10.17 update, we released two hotfixes to the backend (yesterday, October 5; and today, October 6) which should show some improvements to performance. We were able to upload these hotfixes without interruption to the game service.

We will also need to release a client-side hotfix [b]as soon as possible next week[/b], which will resolve some further performance-related issues, including the crashes some players may be experiencing. We are currently testing this hotfix, and we will update players to let you know when it will go live. Please stay tuned to our Twitter for up-to-the-minute updates: [url=https://twitter.com/Quake]https://twitter.com/Quake[/url]

Because this client-side patch will require some downtime, we recognize that this would cut into the Double XP Weekend event that is currently running. Therefore, we have decided to [b]extend[/b] the event for the entire week until [b]next Monday, October 16.[/b] This is just our way of saying thanks for sticking with us and being patient as we fix these issues. 

See you in the Arena!

notes.title: Early Access Update 5.10.17
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/e54bafe0c59b09404667d751c04560c11f162e30.png[/img]

Greetings, Quakers!

Today we're deploying our major update for October that includes numerous changes and improvements for Quake Champions. 

In addition to this update, we will also be holding a [b]DOUBLE XP WEEKEND[/b] from today, October 5, until October 9, so clear your calendar and get ready to frag your opponents! 

Check out the full patch notes:

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]

[list][*]Small Health and Light Armor now grant a consistent value of +25 HP/AP respectively
[*]Improved issues with predictive spawns in Duels[/list]

[h1]Game Options[/h1]

[list][*]Added Auto Weapon Swap option in Game Settings. Players may now automatically switch to a weapon upon pick-up.[/list]

[h1]Projectile Updates & Fixes[/h1]

[list][*]Numerous issues resulting in Rocket Launcher miss hits resolved
[*]Addressed issues when Rocket Launcher might have miss hits after player used active ability
[*]Resolved desync for the projectile that was shot in midair right before players death
[*]Rocket Launcher client-side hit prediction and server-side validation have been improved
[*]Deterministic shot simulation for rockets implemented
[*]Fixed issue where Rocket Launcher projectiles could fly sideways, such that the projectile would be sidewise, not the trajectory[/list]

[h1]Game Client Fixes[/h1]

[list][*]Various memory leaks fixed
[*]Outgoing client traffic optimization improved
[*]UI can now show more than 20 friends in friends list
[*]Addressed issues where users sometimes were unable to fire weapons and lost other functionality, such as only being able to shoot the machinegun (mostly reported by and affecting Canadian players on certain ISPs)
[*]Fixed issue when client could freeze when user changed target display
[*]Load on demand memory optimization support added[/list]

[h1]Champions Balance[/h1] 

[list][*][b]All Champions[/b]  
[list][*]Hero Lighting updated to colorize teammates and enemies at a closer range
[url=https://youtu.be/LmGz3cavVbg]https://youtu.be/LmGz3cavVbg[/url]
[*]Auto-outlining enemies within 256u now instead of 120u[/list]
[*][b]Anarki[/b]  
[list][*]Updated animations to reduce lean while strafing
[url=https://youtu.be/RmNgm7ko5Y4]https://youtu.be/RmNgm7ko5Y4[/url][/list]
[*][b]BJ Blazkowicz[/b]
[list][*]Reduced Dual Wield cooldown from 50 to 48 second
[*]Increased Dual Wield rate of fire for Shotgun, Tri-bolt, Rocket Launcher, and Railgun[/list]
[*][b]Clutch[/b]
[list][*]+25 Health Points
[*]Removed movement penalty while using the Mining Drill[/list]
[*][b]DOOM Slayer[/b]
[list][*]Improved Leap Strike while in Berserk[/list]
[*][b]Scalebearer[/b]
[list][*]+25 max Armor Points[/list]
[*][b]Slash[/b]
[list][*]Plasma Trail can now be performed in any direction[/list]
[*][b]Sorlag[/b]
[list][*]Increased the weapon fire delay after Acid Spit from 600 ms to 1 second
[*]Reduced Acid Spit damage over time (DOT) from 10 to 7, reducing a max of 50 damage to 35 damage[/list]
[*][b]Visor[/b]
[list][*]Changed Piercing Sight VO announcement from global to client-side only
Reduced the cooldown for Piercing Sight from 45 to 43 seconds[/list][/list]

[h1]Weapon Balance[/h1]

[list][*][b]Nailgun (Starting)[/b]
[list][*]Increased rate of fire, resulting in 100 to 133 DPS[/list]
[*][b]Super Shotgun[/b]
[list][*]Lowered spread from 800 to 750[/list]
[*][b]Tri-bolt[/b]
[list][*]Improved visibility of bolts
[*]Bolts explode on impact with enemies (full 50 damage)[/list][/list]

[h1]Economy Updates[/h1]

[list][*]Double XP Weekend from [b]Thursday, October 5th to Monday, October 9th[/b]
[*]Reduced price of Vanity from 600 to 500 platinum
[*]Reduced the dismantle shards for vanity from 150 to 120
[*]Increased the drop rate for icons & nameplates in backpacks
[*]The following bundles will be [b]removed[/b] from the store as of October 5, 2017:
[list][*]Quake 1 Rocket Bundle
[*]Quake 2 Railgun Bundle
[*]Quake 3 Machinegun Bundle
[*]Quake 4 Lightning Gun Bundle
[*]El Diablo Shotgun Bundle
[*]Vanity – Phase Projector[/list]
[*]The following new bundles will be [b]added[/b] to the store as of October 5, 2017:
[list][*]Ranger Raider Complete Set
[*]Ranger Shambler Head
[*]QR3-LL Rocket Launcher
[*]Starter Shader Pack[/list][/list]

[h1]Vanity Updates[/h1]

[list][*]Added Flames head and torso attachments to Anarki’s Bone Daddy costume[/list]

[h1]Lore System Updates & Fixes[/h1]

[list][*]VO "Lore Found" will now only play for the player who reveals the Lore Scroll
[*]Players can no longer earn lore scrolls without completing the match
[*]Lore scroll fixes made to mitigate the farming of scrolls[/list]

[h1]Gore System Updates[/h1]

[list][*]Fixed issue where rag doll could clip through the floor
[*]Fixed issue where no death animation would play upon certain deaths[/list]

[h1]Audio Updates & Fixes[/h1]

[list][*]Win / Loss music added to the post-match Victory Podium
[*]Jumppads now trigger a sound when a player jumps onto the pad, in addition to stepping onto it.
[*]Constructor (Q4 Nailgun) had an in-world audible hum, that is now client-side only[/list]

[h1]UI Updates[/h1]

[list][*]Home screen Champion VO and animations added
[*]Both icons and nameplates are now present on the contact list
[*]Visual update to the post-match Victory Podium, including nameplates
[*]Invite to party now present in context menu in in-menu chat
[*]Store tab art updated
[*]Discounts are shown on price tags in the Store UI[/list]

[h1]Champion Fixes[/h1]

[list][*][b]All Champions[/b]
[list][*]First person weapon animations are no longer missing
[*]Lore sets can no longer be mixed with other costume sets
[*]Fixed issue where some shaders could be applied to some lore sets including Ruby-Nyx
[*]Active abilities can now be used while crouched
[*]Active abilities issued immediately before a player’s death, no longer activate upon respawn
[*]Enemies no longer collide with each other when both players are in motion[/list]
[*][b]Anarki[/b]
[list][*]Should no longer float above his board while in the Match Lobby
[/list][*][b]DOOM Slayer[/b]
[list][*]Added the Silent Protagonist passive ability to the UI

notes.title: Ask Us Anything Answers - September 22, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30423540/10194f590a4775b179e8744659dd4644b5202275.png[/img]

Hey Champions! 

You've been asking us questions, and we've compiled some of the top ones from this week to answer! You can find previous Q&A threads on the official Bethesda.net forums here:

[url=https://bethesda.net/community/topic/90348/ask-us-anything-answers-9-1]Ask Us Anything - September 1[/url]
[url=https://bethesda.net/community/topic/92749/developer-stream-friday-08-09-vod-available]Livestream Q&A Answers[/url]

[b][Questions answered by Lead Designer Adam Pyle][/b]

[b]Q: Are you going to rework some of the rune challenges? Some of them are very difficult, especially for new players. Other challenges require insane luck.[/b]
[b]A:[/b]Yes, absolutely. While it was great to get the Rune System out there to introduce it to players, we plan on going over all of the existing challenges and making adjustments. Some challenges will have their goals adjusted, while others may be replaced entirely.

[b]Will there be more passive ability focus on mobility? (Like wall jump, crouch slide, etc.)[/b]
I think we will continue our current trend of having a mix of passives, some that provide movement mechanics, others than provide gameplay buffs. We certainly have a few Champions slated for next year with movement passives.

[b]Visor’s passive, Full Sprint, is not too useful due to his slow acceleration, especially with small maps. Its uniqueness is also lessened since every character can break their speed cap by rocket/tri-bolt boosting. Will you look at retooling his passive to better match his kit?[/b]
I don’t anticipate changing his passive or adding a new passive ability to Visor. We have some changes coming in the next couple of update that will make his active ability more effective. We’d like to see how Visor plays after making those changes before looking at further changes, but I would be more tempted to increase his acceleration, causing him to make better use of his passive, than change the passive itself.

[b]When will Tim Willits be a playable character?[/b]
We don’t foresee making Tim or any other developers Champions. We have so many Champions right now that we’d like to get into the game.

[b]Are there any ideas for maps with volumetric fog?[/b]
Ideas? Sure. But nothing we're going to capitalize on yet. A lot of players dislike heavy fog maps, and we probably need a lot more maps in our library before we brand out into those.

[b]Are we going to get fast weapon switch?[/b]
Not sure. If it ever is desirable for one of our upcoming modes then we may add the feature and make it available as a Custom Game option, but we probably won’t pursue it until such time.

[b]Will there be a chainsaw skin for the Gauntlet?[/b]
We’d love to have one eventually, but it may present some technical challenges that prevent us from doing so immediately. We would have to build a lot of new animations to support custom melee weapons.

[b]Do you plan to add an option for raw mouse input?[/b]
I would like to eventually add raw mouse input.

Any new info on customizing crosshairs?
No new info yet. I reviewed some crosshair work last week while visiting Saber, but most of this work is planned for October and November.

[b]How is progress going on the zoom sensitivity slider?[/b]
We’re slated to work on those features in October for release later this year.

[b]Can we expect quality of life additions like the client remembering data center choices?[/b]
Yes, this is another one of those features we’re tackling in October for a release later this year.

[b]Can we have the option to disable chat completely to avoid toxic players?[/b]
Perhaps, although I would personally prefer just the ability to mute or report such player behavior so that we may address the issue at hand.

[b]Can we get shaders for our names? I want my colored name back from Q3A![/b]
We’ll discuss it, but there are currently no plans right now for colored names. While they were fun, I actually prefer the clarity gained from being able to have team colored names in UI and chat, and colored names either interfere with that, or you have to choose only select places to display those colored names.

[b]Do you have any information you can share about how ranked will work? Are there different divisions? Will there be different ranks for each ranked mode? (A player having one ranking for Duel, one for TDM, etc.?)[/b]
Currently there are 5 divisions, with room to expand if needed. Players will be able to see their division in all modes, and in ranked play players will see their division rank as well as their MMR value.

[b]Will Custom Game allow us to adjust things like champion stats, item pickup placements, respawn/ability timers?[/b]
While Custom Game does have a lot of planned features, we don’t plan for players to be able to make these adjustments in Custom Game.

[b]Can you talk about what each developer works on for Quake Champions? Specifically, what does id Software do, and what does Saber Interactive do?[/b]
That's not an easy question to answer! We have a lot of developers at both Saber and id. The bulk of design direction comes straight from id, and a lot of the art and programming is done at Saber. But in all cases, we have people at both studios doing work. There's no single part of the game - level design, character creation, programming, animation - that we can point to as being 100% developed by one studio or the other. It's a collaboration.

[h1]Stay tuned for future Ask Us Anything answers from the development team![/h1]

[b]A:[/b]Yes, absolutely. While it was great to get the Rune System out there to introduce it to players, we plan on going over all of the existing challenges and making adjustments. Some challenges will have their goals adjusted, while others may be replaced entirely.

[b]Will there be more passive ability focus on mobility? (Like wall jump, crouch slide, etc.)[/b]
I think we will continue our current trend of having a mix of passives, some that provide movement mechanics, others than provide gameplay buffs. We certainly have a few Champions slated for next year with movement passives.

[b]Visor’s passive, Full Sprint, is not too useful due to his slow acceleration, especially with small maps. Its uniqueness is also lessened since every character can break their speed cap by rocket/tri-bolt boosting. Will you look at retooling his passive to better match his kit?[/b]
I don’t anticipate changing his passive or adding a new passive ability to Visor. We have some changes coming in the next couple of update that will make his active ability more effective. We’d like to see how Visor plays after making those changes before looking at further changes, but I would be more tempted to increase his acceleration, causing him to make better use of his passive, than change the passive itself.

[b]When will Tim Willits be a playable character?[/b]
We don’t foresee making Tim or any other developers Champions. We have so many Champions right now that we’d like to get into the game.

[b]Are there any ideas for maps with volumetric fog?[/b]
Ideas? Sure. But nothing we're going to capitalize on yet. A lot of players dislike heavy fog maps, and we probably need a lot more maps in our library before we brand out into those.

[b]Are we going to get fast weapon switch?[/b]
Not sure. If it ever is desirable for one of our upcoming modes then we may add the feature and make it available as a Custom Game option, but we probably won’t pursue it until such time.

[b]Will there be a chainsaw skin for the Gauntlet?[/b]
We’d love to have one eventually, but it may present some technical challenges that prevent us from doing so immediately. We would have to build a lot of new animations to support custom melee weapons.

[b]Do you plan to add an option for raw mouse input?[/b]
I would like to eventually add raw mouse input.

Any new info on customizing crosshairs?
No new info yet. I reviewed some crosshair work last week while visiting Saber, but most of this work is planned for October and November.

[b]How is progress going on the zoom sensitivity slider?[/b]
We’re slated to work on those features in October for release later this year.

[b]Can we expect quality of life additions like the client remembering data center choices?[/b]
Yes, this is another one of those features we’re tackling in October for a release later this year.

[b]Can we have the option to disable chat completely to avoid toxic players?[/b]
Perhaps, although I would personally prefer just the ability to mute or report such player behavior so that we may address the issue at hand.

[b]Can we get shaders for our names? I want my colored name back from Q3A![/b]
We’ll discuss it, but there are currently no plans right now for colored names. While they were fun, I actually prefer the clarity gained from being able to have team colored names in UI and chat, and colored names either interfere with that, or you have to choose only select places to display those colored names.

[b]Do you have any information you can share about how ranked will work? Are there different divisions? Will there be different ranks for each ranked mode? (A player having one ranking for Duel, one for TDM, etc.?)[/b]
Currently there are 5 divisions, with room to expand if needed. Players will be able to see their division in all modes, and in ranked play players will see their division rank as well as their MMR value.

[b]Will Custom Game allow us to adjust things like champion stats, item pickup placements, respawn/ability timers?[/b]
While Custom Game does have a lot of planned features, we don’t plan for players to be able to make these adjustments in Custom Game.

[b]Can you talk about what each developer works on for Quake Champions? Specifically, what does id Software do, and what does Saber Interactive do?[/b]
That's not an easy question to answer! We have a lot of developers at both Saber and id. The bulk of design direction comes straight from id, and a lot of the art and programming is done at Saber. But in all cases, we have people at both studios doing work. There's no single part of the game - level design, character creation, programming, animation - that we can point to as being 100% developed by one studio or the other. It's a collaboration.

[h1]Stay tuned for future Ask Us Anything answers from the development team![/h1]
